The convergence of technology and fashion is tested through the lens of these generative models, contributing personalized and mesmerizing virtual try-on experiences. Our research gives out a step-by-step process on how we can create a virtual try on system, incorporating Machine Learning and Computer Vision technologies. It tells us about the integration of E-Commerce platforms and optimization of real-time applications. This digital evolution not only addresses existing hurdles but propels the fashion industry into a seamless, engaging, and personalized future.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Solar Powered Electric Cart for University Campus
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In light of the ongoing global challenges posed by climate change, the imperative to shift towards sustainable energy sources has become more pronounced. Renewable energy options like solar and wind power offer a cleaner and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional fossil fuels. Additionally, the widespread integration of electric vehicles (EVs) has the potential to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions, simultaneously enhancing air quality. The solar energy can be used to power up the electric vehicles. The basic principle of a solar based electric vehicle is to charge a battery using solar energy and use the stored energy in the battery to drive the motor, propelling the vehicle forward. The Photo Voltaic (PV) module may be connected either in parallel or in series, and the charge controllers along with batteries are used to provide the supply to electro-mechanical machine. In this simulation, a solar-powered electric cart is designed and simulated using the MATLAB Simulink platform. The cart is designed to carry a load of up to 600 kg, including both the vehicle’s weight and the payload. It can travel at a speed of 25 km/h. The cart is powered by a Li-ion battery, which provides 12 kW of power to a BLDC motor rated at 4000W. A 660W solar array, mounted on the roof, ensures a steady recharging process for the lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Modelling of Ultra-Lift Luo Converter Using PI Controller for Stand Alone Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this paper Ultra Lift Luo Converter (ULC) with a high voltage transfer gain in comparison to other Luo converters is proposed. A technique called voltage-lift (VL) has been tested for years to yield transfer gain with a boosted voltage. In the proposed model, ultra-lift (UL) technique has been used, the open-loop and closed-loop analysis of ULC with PI control yields graphical results that highlights the relationship about the duty cycle and voltage transfer gain is implemented and verified by using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Dual Active Bridge Converters – A Comparative Analysis using MATLAB Simulink for Photovoltaic Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: One of the thorough solutions to interface PV array with the load is by by means of Dual Active Bridge converters. DAB converters possess the advantage of galvanic isolation, voltage to conversion ratio is more and improved efficiency when compared to various other converters. In this paper, exploration of Dual Active Bridge converters is undertaken. Initially, working of DAB converter is analyzed using a DC source then PV array is interfaced with DAB, Perturb & Observe MPPT algorithm is used for Voltage and current control. Interface of PV array with DAB converter is fed to inverter for which the AC motor is connected as a load. The Analysis of various proposed model as mentioned above is simulated using Simulink and the results are corroborated.

articleTitle: IoT Based Inverter for Autonomous Electric Vehicle Drive using CIPOS IPM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Intelligent power modules (IPM) play a crucial role in the evolution of motor control technology. These modules combine various power semiconductor devices, such as MOSFETs and IGTs, along with control circuitry in a compact and integrated package. As the number of electrical motors continues to grow, IPMs offer efficient and reliable solutions for smart and modern Motor Control applications, addressing the increasing demand for CO2 reduction and energy efficiency. The abstract concludes with an acknowledgement of the critical role IPMs play in shaping the future of motor control, fostering progress and sustainability across diverse sectors.

articleTitle: RSA Cryptosystem with Parallel Thread Execution using Dual Public Keys
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the need for computer security, number theory and more specifically the Rivest–Shamir–Adleman (RSA) techniques are essential to assure safe data transfer. A crucial component for protecting sensitive information when users and websites communicate is the encryption and decryption process. The encryption and decryption procedures employ keys. Modular exponentiation is a technique used by the public key RSA cryptosystem to encrypt and decrypt communications. However, the fact that the public key is communicated through a public channel raises questions about RSA’s security, leading to the usage of chaos to improve data security. Various applications use customized variants of the RSA algorithm to increase efficiency and security, including voice and picture encryption. In this paper, the proposed method shows that RSA encryption uses threads and dual public keys to reduce execution time when compared to regular RSA cryptosystems.

articleTitle: Restaurant Feasibility Study and Behavioural based Restaurant Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research paper harnesses spatial analysis and data science to revolutionize restaurant setup and user recommendation strategies within the online food ordering domain, focusing on the 5% of users contributing rating. By aggregating user rating data and spatial information, the methodology conducts in depth exploratory data analysis of unwilling distribution pattern and spatial co-relation among user demographic, locations and rating. Employing special tool, it map restaurant location identify underserved or competitive areas and applies clustering algorithm to understand localized user preferences. Behavioral pattern analysis segment users, develop predictive models, and construct recommendation engine, a bling personalize restaurant suggestions. Business recommendation encompass optimal restaurant placements, targeted marketing strategies, and operational optimization based on identify user’s preference. Rigorous model evaluation ensure accuracy, with iterative refinement for continuous enhancement empowering restaurant owner with data driven insights per strategic decision making and offering tailored dining recommendations to users.

articleTitle: Integrated Traffic Control System for Emergency Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The efficient movement of ambulances is crucial for timely response and effective emergency management in urban areas. However, congested road networks often impede their progress, leading to potentially life-threatening delays. It presents an innovative solution: an automated traffic system for emergency vehicles utilizing RF (Radio Frequency) modules. By harnessing RF technology, this system enables seamless communication and coordination betweenambulances and the road infrastructure. Real-time vehicle identification, intelligent traffic management algorithms, and enhanced safety measures are key features of this system. By dynamically managing traffic flow, optimizing signal timings, and granting priority access to ambulances, the system minimizes response times while minimizing disruption to regular traffic. Moreover, the integration of RF modules paves the way for future advancements, including predictive routing and adaptive traffic management. The implementation of this automated traffic system holds immense potential to revolutionize emergency response, enhance road safety, and save lives in our increasingly complex urban environments.

articleTitle: Live Temperature Monitoring System Using MQTT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The Message Queue Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol has been used to create an Internet of Things (IoT) monitoring system that displays temperature and humidity values within a room. A well-known internet-based communication protocol called MQTT was chosen for the experiment, where it is used to send data on temperature and humidity. This experiment intends to test the sensor's functionality and the MQTT protocol's applicability in a variety of specially designed test rooms. The purpose of these settings, which include cold, normal, and heat, is to determine how well the sensor functions under each one.The monitoring system includes DHT11 humidity and temperature sensors, which produce data displaying the current humidity and temperature levels. The Node MCU microcontroller, which has the capacity to connect to the internet via a Wi-Fi network, receives this data after that. Broker.mqttdashboard.com has been selected as the MQTT broker for this system. With MQTT Box for laptops and the MQTT Dashboard app for Android, it is possible to monitor temperature on a laptop and an Android device.This system's data collection offers insights into three different temperature and humidity situations. The typical temperature and humidity levels in cold weather are 15.0°C and 69.39%, respectively. The average temperature and humidity rise to 31.3 °C and 87.9 % under normal circumstances. The average temperature and humidity levels increase to 40.65°C in hot weather.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Novel 16-Bit Vedic Multiplier Using Carry Look Ahead Adder for High Speed and Low Area in Comparison with Carry Select Adder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research evaluates a unique carry look ahead adder (CLA) 16-bit Vedic multiplier's efficiency. Optimise speed and space utilisation and compare it to the standard carry select adder (CSA) design. Two sets of samples were tested to compare the carry select adder (CSLA) and unique carry look ahead adder. The first group included 10 CSLA samples and the second 10 CLA samples. ModelSim and VHDL were used for the evaluation. Propagation delay and power consumption were the main design evaluation criteria. The CSLA and CLA simulation results were obtained by running two sets of 10 samples each. Power utilisation was calculated using G-power with a 95% confidence interval. After the simulation, the data were analysed to determine each creative design's pros and cons. Analysis of both systems' propagation delay and power consumption provided crucial performance insights, helping choose the best design for certain applications. Results: The CLA had an average propagation delay of 15.5 ns and the CSLA 20.7 ns. The CLA used 2.4 mW and the CSLA 3.6 mW. A low p-value of 0.001 indicates statistical significance (p<0.05). Conclusion: The CLA performs better for fast-processing, low-power workloads. Thus, the unique CLA adder should be considered for use in high-performance digital circuits.

articleTitle: Speech Modeling with Linear Auto Regressive and Nonlinear Hammerstein Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper aims to explore speech modeling through the utilization of both a Linear Autoregressive (AR) model and a Nonlinear Hammerstein model. A comparative analysis was conducted, encompassing both clear and noisy speech samples, to assess the appropriateness of the linear autoregressive model for speech by examining the prediction errors it generates. This evaluation involved measuring the performance of the linear autoregressive model in comparison to the Hammerstein model for speech, using the error signal and the application of the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC). The findings from this study indicate that the proposed approach results in enhancements in terms of error reduction, particularly in scenarios characterized by low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). Additionally, the obtained AIC measurements also suggest that the nonlinear model is better suited for modeling audio signals when contrasted with the AR model.

articleTitle: A Systematic Investigation on Different Scene Text Detection and Recognition Method using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The method of scene text detection and recognition is useful in a variety of applications ranging from multimedia retrieval, traffic monitoring, and navigation for visually impaired individuals to semantic natural scene understanding. Many researchers have worked hard to create algorithms for detecting and recognizing text in photos and movies. The three major areas of scene text recognition are detection, recognition, and end-to-end text recognition systems. Scene text detection and recognition systems have significant challenges due to scene complexity, text diversity, and real-time constraints. The traditional optical character recognition method focuses on recognizing words from image sources but fails to identify multi-oriented and multi-lingual languages. Proposed deep learning approach combined with neural network based scene text detection and recognition method achieves competitive performance. It is critical in complicated scene and large scale dataset detection and identification, multilingual and multi-oriented detection and recognition, real time detection and recognition, and visual understanding. Integrated approach helps to localize, detect and recognize the text in different orientation and multi-language. Also it will reduce the recognition error by employing the advantage of dictionary search method. Proposed approach will provide reasonable performance for curve text, real time video and image files. On several standard text detection benchmarks, it will obtain competitive results in terms of speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Power of Deep Learning for Corn Rust Disease Severity Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Maize crops get hit hard by corn rust, a big disease that affects farming all over the world's food production. Traditional ways of finding diseases and putting them in groups are basic, but often limited by what people think about it. They don't work well when needed for a large number of cases. This study shows a new method using Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), which is deep learning (DL). It helps to correctly identify the degree of damage from corn rust disease. The study shows that the MLP model works well in finding and classifying disease stages using a set of 3500 and pictures from six levels. The MLP model was carefully made and taught to recognize small changes in disease levels. It puts importance on being right, exact, and remembering everything about it all the time. The machine reached 94.20% accuracy, showing it could be useful for people working with plants and those who farm. The MLP was faster, more scalable, and gave better results than other computer learning methods. It did a great job! This study aids the increasing mix of artificial intelligence and farming that's precise. It shows how DL can help solve tough agriculture problems. The results show that the MLP model can help manage crop diseases. It helps in quick and effective actions to stop these problems from causing more harm. For the future, we want to make the model stronger. We also plan on using it for other sicknesses and adding it to farming systems that check things in real-time right away. The research opens the door for better farming methods that are both green and save energy, driven by smart machines.

articleTitle: Brain-Computer Interface Research Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: People have long desired for the ability to communicate with technology merely by thought or for the creation of gadgets that can see into the minds and thoughts of others. Ancient mythology and contemporary science fiction stories are two examples of how these concepts have gripped the imagination of humanity. However, it has only recently become feasible for humans to have direct contact with the human brain because to developments in cognitive neuroscience and brain imaging technologies. Researchers have developed brain computer interfaces (BCIs) using these technologies, which are communication devices that doesn't depends on the brain's typical output channels of muscles and peripheral nerves. The expanding societal understanding of the requirements of those with physical disabilities has served as the main driving force behind this endeavour. Users in these systems purposefully alter their brain activity rather of generating signals that are capable of being utilised to operate computers or communication devices through bodily actions.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Stock Prices: The Co-Movements of Sectoral Models of Index Market in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The Indian stock market, has always been dynamic and diverse in nature, comprising industries across various sectors. Financial knowledge about the co-movements among the sectors is of utmost importance for investors and market participants. This study examines the comprehensive comparative analysis of stock price among four different sectors listed in the National Stock Exchange (NSE), utilizing forecasting models such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA). This work leverages the Nifty sectoral index and implementing time-series and machine learning techniques. This research provides insights about the financial co-relation within the sectors, contributing to informed investment decisions. This sectoral analysis performed using LSTM and ARIMA, enhances the understanding of the sectoral stock market’s behavior. This research also emphasizes the efficacy of LSTM and ARIMA models in enriching the finance and stock market analysis and comprehends the factors driving stock price co-movements in India, enhancing investment strategies. The meticulous use of a robust dataset and advanced analytical techniques ensures the credibility of our findings, emphasizing the significance of understanding intricate sectoral and industry relationships in India’s stock market, accentuated by the application of advanced models like LSTM and ARIMA.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Design and Development of Hybrid Land and Water Buoyancy Trash Collecting Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Environmental pollution, especially in aquatic ecosystems, poses an important risk to the planet. The proliferation of plastic discarded in water bodies has prompted the development of innovative technologies to address this crisis. This abstract introduces a novel solution in the form of a Hybrid Land and Water Buoyancy Trash Collecting Robot. It is designed to operate both on land and in aquatic environments, providing a versatile and efficient solution for collecting and removing debris from water bodies A working version of the robot has two propellers that are coupled to two DC motors to allow for left, right, and forward motion. Robot control with an application-based WIFI control system remotely and with a robotic hand to facilitate the collection of rubbish. A system of conveyor belts directing the garbage to the collecting box and a protective sensor organization besides the overindulgence of information. The prototype itself uses just 12 volts of battery power to clear an area of around 1500 square centimeters and gather rubbish up to 7 kilograms in weight. The robot can operate continuously for two hours without requiring a charge. The collected waste is then securely stored and can be later transferred to disposal facilities for proper recycling or disposal.

articleTitle: Electrode Engineering of Nano-pillar Based CdS/CdTe Solar cell
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: With an inventive design that integrates electrodes on the same plane and back side of the device, the workfunction of electrodes is modified from 4.8 to 5.9 with the goal of improving the photovoltaic performance of a Nanopillar(NP) based n-CdS/p-CdTe solar cell. The investigation was conducted using TCAD Silvaco, semiconductor device simulator based on physics. By varying the work function, 2 points are observed to have a better performance than others. One peak corresponds the effective collection of electrons (cathode side collection) and the other corresponds to the effective collection holes (anode side collection).

articleTitle: Navigation of a Novel Wheelchair Designed for Multi-level Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)

authors.preferredName: Bhamidipati S D K S S Srinivas
authors.firstName: Bhamidipati S D K S S

abstract: Persons with disabilities experience difficulties when navigating in areas with multiple levels. In scenarios such as entering or exiting of public transport systems, they are forced to relay on caregiver support. The challenge to board a train compartment in railway stations is significantly higher. The scope of this work is to introduce a novel design for a wheelchair which will provide mechanisms for entraining and detraining. Additionally, the wheelchair is equipped with a vision sensor that can help detect the train compartment door and generate a path to it. After reaching the door, the wheelchair entrains the compartment autonomously using an entraining sequence. The door is detected using an object detection model which plots a bounding box where the door is located. Using the bounding box coordinates, the position of the door relative to the wheelchair is estimated. The path generated is an optimized one so as to move the wheelchair efficiently towards the compartment door.

articleTitle: Voltage control in a ZETA Converter compared with a DC-DC converter by varying duty cycle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Objective of this work is to regulate the output voltage by using voltage control with different modulation techniques. Materials and Methods: A Zeta converter(ZC) is compared with a DC-DC converter to identify where the voltage is implemented and investigated so as to identify the varying duty cycle. The sample size is computed using Gpower software for two groups, and there are 14 samples used. The G power is taken as 0.8.. Zeta Converter and DC-DC Converter in that Zeta is the best output voltage. The independent sample t test value obtained is 0.045 (p < 0.05), which is significant compared to DC-DC converter. Based on the simulation results, the proposed system Zeta converter with an input voltage range of 20 volts can produce an output voltage of 45 volts using modeling and control.

articleTitle: High Frequency Transient Behavior of Oil Filled Instrument Transformer against Transients Generated During Switching Of High Voltage Disconnector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Instrument transformers play vital role in high voltage substation to measure and protect the power system network from abnormal conditions. These instrument transformers mainly stressed due to switching transients generated due to operation of high voltage disconnectors in the substation. This transient overvoltage is transferred to low voltage secondary circuit via capacitive or inductive coupling phenomenon. Transient over voltages and electromagnetic disturbances in secondary circuit of Instrument transformers are of main concern to power utilities due to connection of sensitive intelligent /digital electronics-based measuring and protection systems. The level of transmitted over voltages from primary circuit to secondary circuit depends on the transfer capability of the instrument transformer due to capacitive and inductive coupling. In this work, an attempt is made to evaluate the transfer capability of instrument transformer against transient voltages and other effects such as steepness of transient voltage, connected burden, length of coaxial cable etc.

articleTitle: Analysis of Leaf Disease Detection in the Solanaceae family plants using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The paper aims to classifying and predicting diseases for leaf images using random forest and convolutional neural networks and compare these two methods. The Indian economy is heavily dependent on agricultural productivity to meet the demands of citizens and support farmers. Unfortunately, crop diseases and pests lead to significant reductions in crop production and quality, which underscores the importance of early detection in precision agriculture. However, manually identifying these problems over large areas of the farm is both time-consuming and labor-intensive. The current work is implemented for Solanaceae families such as potatoes, tomatoes, and pepper plants. Initially, the Random Forest classification method was implemented, which achieved an accuracy of 67.90%. Further, the experiments with the CNN model extended resulted in a significant improvement with an accuracy level of 95.53% after training and testing.

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Detection on Edge Devices Using Mobile Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In an era when edge computing rapidly evolves, this study addresses the significant difficulty of real-time object identification on resource-constrained edge devices. We provide a unique neural network model for edge scenarios in this paper. Our model covers object recognition system accuracy, computational efficiency, and speed. Object detection methods that need processing are impractical for edge computing. This paper proposes a Mobile Neural Network tailored to the limitations. Pruning, which decreases model size by 30%, and quantization make the model efficient. On several edge devices, the model had an average accuracy of 92% on Dataset 1 and 89% on Dataset 2. The model's 40-millisecond inference time and 2.3-watt power consumption were impressive. It outperformed standard CNN models and edge-optimized algorithms like YOLOv3 and SSD MobileNet under identical conditions. This study shows that the proposed paradigm can revolutionise edge computing real-time object detection. The model is suitable for high-responsiveness, energy-efficient applications.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Hybrid Deep Learning for Accurate Pepper Leaf Mosaic Virus Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research presents a new way to sort out the stages of pepper leaf mosaic virus illness using an advanced learning model. It combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for this purpose. This study looks at how using space and time data can improve the way we find out about plant diseases, which is a better method than what we already have. The set of pictures has 10,500 illness images sorted into different health stages. These were handled and used to teach the model about disease by testing it out too. The suggested CNN-LSTM mix model uses the skill of CNN to get space details from leaf pictures and LSTM's ability to look at how these features change over time. This mix is made to make disease stage classification better and faster. The model got a total correctness of 96.5%, much better than single CNN and LSTM models. The model was very good when checked with new data. This shows it can work well in real life too. The results of this study are very important for precision farming and plant disease research. The fused CNN-LSTM model is very accurate and works well in most cases. This makes it great for finding plant diseases early, which can help manage them better to save more crops from getting sick. The study also shows where more research can be done in the future. This includes changing models to fit different environmental situations and sick plants, along with not depending too much on big sets of data.

articleTitle: Exploring the Implications of IoT Integration in Urban Infrastructures for Sustainable Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Global cities are undergoing revolutionary changes thanks to the widespread adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies Watermarking algorithms must adapt to adversarial approaches. Protecting and circumventing digital material involves ongoing study and modification. Fast integration and retrieval make these technologies ideal for real-time applications. These technologies help fast-paced industries like media transmission and live streaming. Existing approaches are promising yet challenging. The need for consistent legislation, open data policies, and inclusive urban planning was a common theme among respondents. The study proposes a strategic framework for implementing IoT in urban areas based on the findings. It places an emphasis on group decision-making, broad consultation, and strict regulation. Citizens, technologists, and urban planners all have a role in ensuring that smart city development is sustainable, secure, and ultimately beneficial for all people. The Internet of Things has the potential to drastically improve city infrastructures. While its advantages can greatly improve urban sustainability and efficiency, overcoming obstacles and ensuring the complete creation of smart urban environments require careful planning and cooperation amongst several sectors.

articleTitle: Person Identification using Periocular Region
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The world has been affected by the corona virus epidemic, which soon turned into a pandemic. The need for face masks and social isolation highlight the need for contact-free biometric authentication for all future systems. Periocular biometric, which does not require physical contact is a solution in such scenarios because it can detect people wearing face masks. The term "periocular region" describes the region around the eye, which includes a variety of elements such the sclera, eyelids, lashes, brows, and skin. Our method involves extraction of the region of interest by cropping the periocular region of every facial image. CLAHE is then performed on each periocular image extracted. For feature extraction, VGG16 and ResNet50 CNN models are employed. KNN classifiers are used for classification of the image. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an accuracy of 80% with ResNet50 and 75% with VGG16 on a challenging dataset consisting of 24 subjects with significant variations in pose, illumination, and expression. The proposed approach offers a promising solution for noninvasive and contactless biometric identification, which can have broad applications in security and surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Improved Grey Wolf Optimization Abetting Fuzzy Logic Controllers Used for Load Frequency Control in Two-Area Interlinked Reheat Thermal Power Plants applying Governor Dead Band and Generation Rate Constraint Non-Linearity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The need of a fast, effective and economical controller for load frequency control has been established in this paper. The primary aim is to conduct an investigation into the effectiveness of P.I.D. and FUZZY LOGIC controller applied to load frequency control (LFC) of interlinked power system with non-linearity by applying optimization. As it is already known when certain input variables and the related output variables do not have a linear or proportional connection, this is referred to as non-linearity in power systems. In other words, changes in input parameters do not always correspond to changes in output parameters in a straight proportion. Instead, the system’s behaviour displays nonlinear traits, which can make analysis and control more difficult and complicated. In order to preserve system stability, efficiency, and the capacity to maintain a constant frequency and voltage, dealing with non-linearity in power systems is crucial. Fuzzy logic, optimization, and adaptive control are examples of sophisticated modelling and control approaches that engineers and researchers frequently use to better understand and handle non-linear phenomena and guarantee the stable functioning of power systems. Considering the domain of global optimization and engineering design challenges, the Improved Grey Wolf Optimization (I-GWO) offers a highly effectual and sturdy approach. This improvement seeks to solve some of the drawbacks of the conventional Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) method while applying it to a system having GRC and GDB non-linearity.

articleTitle: Exploring Novel Anticancer Peptides: Evolutionary Prediction of Potential tRNA-Encoded Peptides for Targeted Therapies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: tRNA-Encoded Peptides (tREPs) are novel functional peptides that show potential as anti-parasitic therapies. In this, in silico study were carried out to create tRNA-encoded peptides with the potential to target the Anti-Apoptotic B-Cell Lymphoma-2 (Bcl-2) protein associated with Cancer Cell Survival and Resistance. This study explores the potential of tREPs as a novel class of anticancer peptide candidates. The research begins by creating tREPs from genomic tRNA sequences and carefully selecting two promising candidates, Pep1 and Pep2, based on various properties, including toxicity and half-life. Molecular docking analyses of Pep1 and Pep2 with the BCL2 protein, a key player in cancer cell survival, demonstrate robust binding interactions with strong HADDOCK scores. Detailed binding interaction assessments unveil the presence of hydrophobic interactions and hydrogen bonds contributing to complex stability. Molecular dynamics simulations confirm the stability of both complexes overtime. The peptide Pep1 (DWIAWRHHNDIVSWLTCGP RFKSWS) exhibited a good binding affinity of -103.5 +/- 1.3 with RMSD values of 0.6 nm and binding free energy -26.41 kcal/mol, indicating its potential as an effective anticancer therapeutic agent. Thus, this study underscores the potential of tREPs as a new frontier in anticancer peptide research and sheds light on the molecular interactions that could target therapies for cancer treatment, with Pep1 emerging as a promising candidate. These findings contribute to the ongoing pursuit of innovative anticancer drug development strategies.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety through Innovative Traffic Sign Detection and Recognition with YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Traffic signs are vital for maintaining smooth traffic flow and preventing accidents, conveying crucial information to drivers through pictorial representations. However, drivers often overlook these signs, leading to potential accidents due to factors like difficulty in focusing, fatigue, and environmental conditions. To tackle this issue, innovative machine-learning techniques have been developed. While traditional traffic sign detection relied on conventional object detection methods, recent advancements, particularly the YOLOv5 (’You Only Look Once’) algorithm, have significantly improved accuracy and speed. YOLOv5, with its grid structure, is renowned for achieving a remarkable accuracy rate of 90.25%. Our proposed solution leverages YOLOv5 for object detection, dividing images into a grid to locate objects efficiently. The technology not only enhances accuracy but also provides real-time analysis and alerts users through audio signals. In future work, our goal is to further enhance the model’s accuracy, expand its capabilities for detecting various signs, and implement it in real-time applications.

articleTitle: Road Feature extraction using CNN and GRU in edge-enabled vehicular cloud networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Efficient and accurate road feature recognition has a vital part in securing road safety and enhancing the driving experience. Poor road conditions, such as potholes, uneven surfaces, and lack of proper road markings, can lead to a higher risk of accidents, including vehicle damage and personal injury. In this study, we present a hybrid model (CNN+RNN) for the improved categorization of road characteristics. Specifically, we use RNN to take on GRU and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) based on MobileNetV2 architecture.MobileNetV2's lightweight architecture ensures real-time processing and model portability, making it a valuable asset for in-vehicle applications. Existing LSTMs are computationally expensive, especially when dealing with long sequences. CNN-MobileNetV2-GRU model provides enhanced capabilities for road feature recognition. We evaluate our model on extensive road feature datasets and demonstrate its superior performance in comparison to the existing CNN-LSTM model. This is particularly beneficial for detecting dynamic road conditions and speed bump occurrences, as it considers the evolution of features over time. By integrating these two components, our model offers a holistic solution for road feature classification. We here process the data collected from edge to the cloud, which requires a lot of space, efficiency, and fastness for these requirements this hybrid algorithm is best. The CNN-MobileNetV2-GRU model not only exhibits higher accuracy but also operates with reduced computational resources, making it suitable for uses in the real world, such as driverless cars and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Our research suggests that this strategy can greatly enhance both road safety and the driving experience in general. fastness for these requirements this hybrid algorithm is best. The CNN-MobileNetV2-GRU model not only exhibits higher accuracy but also operates with reduced computational resources, making it suitable for uses in the real world, such as driverless cars and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Our research suggests that this strategy can greatly enhance both road safety and the driving experience in general.

articleTitle: Development of PIN Diode Based Commandable Ku-band Attenuator Network For TT&C Downlinks of Geo Imaging Satellites
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Geo Imaging Satellite’s orientation is subjected to several biases for pointing on-board camera towards the region of interest. In-orbit telemetry of Geo Imaging Satellite is phase modulated on Ku-Band carrier and downlinked through Phased Array Antenna (PAA) to ensure that the coverage is limited to the Indian national region in spite of spacecraft biases. As PAA is not compatible with the phase modulation based tone ranging performed through Ku-Band TT&C Transponder in geo spacecrafts, a High Gain Antenna (HGA) is incorporated to support ranging operations in Ku-Band. Ku- Band downlink signal is to be switched to HGA during ranging operations by means of a commandable switching network.This paper describes the design, development and realization of Ku-Band attenuator network that is designed to route downlink signals to PAA or HGA based on the mission requirements while ensuring that there are no single point failures. It includes the details of frequent ranging requirement for Geo Imaging Satellite compared to other spacecrafts, need for HGA, system level architecture of Ku-Band attenuator network, circuit level design & simulation, hardware realization and performance of flight hardware.

articleTitle: GAN Generated Fake Human Face Image Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In recent years, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have revolutionized the generation of synthetic data that closely mimics real-world distributions. This research paper focuses on detecting fake human face images generated through GANs. The paper provides a thorough analysis of the current state of GAN-generated fake human face detection and proposes a novel method for robust detection. Existing detection methods often struggle with newly emerging GAN architectures, lack generalization capabilities, and are prone to adversarial attacks. In this paper, authors propose an efficient Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture that detects StyleGAN3-generated fake human faces. To enhance the robustness of the model the algorithm employs a series of filters to extract image data, performs grayscale normalization and convolutional operations to find out whether the images are fake or real with more accuracy. The outcomes of the experiments demonstrate that the approach outperforms the current systems in terms of robustly identifying fake images. Authors achieved an accuracy of 99.42%. This system can be integrated into social media platforms to identify fake profile pictures or deepfake images that are often used for impersonation or spreading misinformation.

articleTitle: Prediction of Global Horizontal Irradiance based on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Grid management is made more challenging by the unpredictable nature of solar resources as solar dispersion rates continue to increase. The intermittent and unpredictable nature of renewable energy sources' power supply makes grid integration one of the biggest hurdles. Thus, it becomes crucial to anticipate solar power to maintain grid stability, permit an ideal unit commitment, and enable cost-effective dispatch. Every year, new methods and strategies are developed globally to improve model accuracy to lower forecast uncertainty. Explaining artificial intelligence’s (AI) decision-making process is challenging due to its "black box" character, especially in complicated models such as neural networks. Concerns concerning the accuracy and dependability of outcomes generated by AI are raised by this opacity. The development of explainable AI techniques to clarify the decision-making process underlying AI-generated predictions is strongly encouraged in order to address this issue, which is critical for ensuring confidence, accountability, and ethical use of AI. To address this problem, this study proposes several machine learning-based techniques, such as decision trees (DT), random forest (RF), extra trees (ET), and extreme gradient boosting (XGB) used to forecast the global horizontal irradiance (GHI) using an explainable AI model, which determines the most significant factor for the estimation and derive a basis for the estimation outcomes employing an explainable AI.

articleTitle: Battery Consumption Optimization in Electric Vehicles using Gyroscope Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In order for an electric car to function, batteries are essential. The battery's use is a significant issue. Optimized battery power usage is the main topic of this project. This is achieved by efficiently providing power while considering the various terrains the vehicle travels. The communication between the sensors and motors, which includes data retrieval and analysis for later use, is the central idea of this work. A mobile application that allows users to create an account and log in to a real-time database serves as the foundation of this project. The mobile application will also have a control panel through which the user may direct the Raspberry Pi to move the model. The Raspberry Pi, which is mounted on the model, will provide feedback on the amount of battery life used at certain points. The user controls the model through an app, and then the raspberry pi interacts with the app to regulate the model during the first stage of the communication process. The pi transmits data from the model on the battery consumption at various moments throughout the second step.

articleTitle: Clinical Text Classification Using Sequential Forward Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Clinical text classification is a critical undertaking within the realm of Natural Language Processing, holding significant implications for healthcare applications. In this NLP project, our primary objective is the categorization of medical transcripts into their corresponding medical conditions. To accomplish this, we harness the power of Sequential Forward Selection (SFS), a feature selection technique meticulously chosen for its capacity to streamline data dimensions. By employing SFS, our project aspires to not only enhance classification performance but also elevate the efficiency of pattern recognition, ensuring both speed and accuracy in disease identification. This research contribution underscores the pivotal role of Clinical Text Classification, with a specific focus on optimizing the process using SFS.

articleTitle: Voice Controlled Smart Home for Disabled
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Voice control-based systems have become the ubiquitous means of communicating with smart devices all thanks to the advances in the domain of Internet of Things. This has led to massive expansion in adoption of home automation systems by many households. In this paper, a speech recognition-based module is utilized to record and process the voice-based speech commands, that are converted to text data. The Node MCU system with Bluetooth connectivity serves to handle the voice commands and allows for controlling of gadgets such as lights. The Node MCU based microcontroller system utilizes the natural language processing techniques to create a voice-activated home automation system allowing the house owners to operate a variety of electric and electronic gadgets and appliances. The Node MCU connects with the respective applications using communication protocols.

articleTitle: Assessment of Breathing Variations to Recognize Respiratory Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Nasal inhalation has a dual role in respiration and affecting olfactory perceptions in the limbic areas of the brain. This dual function emphasizes the significance of analyzing nasal airflow data in Neurology and Pulmonology. Understanding respiratory function involves examining breathing patterns at various instant of time which seems to be challenging with current clinical setting recording display system. To assess the breathing pattern at different instant of time, there is a need for better analysis tool which can help in early recognition of respiratory disorders like asthma, COPD, Sleep Apnea etc. This study makes use of the traditional respiratory recording system and shows the breathing variations through automated calculation of breathing rate and inter breath interval and overcomes the limitations of current respiratory recorders in terms of analysis. The recorded breathing patterns were analyzed with and without windowing/segmentation. It can be inferred from the experimental study that the variations between the segmentation and non-segmentation found to be crucial for clinical decisions. Further the statistical Bland–Altman plot showed a breathing rate variation of 0.2733± 2.5336 breath per minute (bpm) and -0.7036±2.0973 breath per minute (bpm) with and without segmentation from that of results obtained using Capnostream™35 Portable Respiratory Monitor. The results indicate that the non-segmented analysis is better suited for applications that require a consistent and stable measurement, while the segmented analysis is more essential for complicated stage of respiratory disorders. Furthermore, the calculation of additional feature, inter-breath interval shows the longevity of breathing patterns which is very much essential for studying respiratory disorders.

articleTitle: Improving Disease Detection in Tomato Leaves Using Visual Geometry Group 19 Compared to the Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: By comparing the efficiency of the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) technique and the Novel Visual Geometry Group 19 (VGG19) algorithm, this research aimed to enhance the precision of the detection of tomato leaf diseases. Using a dataset consisting of 19,167 photographs, each of which measured 171 rows and 171 columns, the Artificial Neural Network method and Visual Geometry Group 16 were both used in order to identify tomato leaf disease. ClinCalc was used to pick a sample size of ten, providing a pretest power of 0.8 and an alpha of 0.05. This was done in order to assess the effectiveness of each method. Following 10 rounds, the performance of each algorithm was evaluated based on its degrees of accuracy. An average precision of 92.12% was achieved by the Novel Visual Geometry Group 19, which was superior to the mean accuracy of 84.43% that the Artificial Neural Network Algorithm achieved. The two algorithms were subjected to a statistical analysis revealing a statistically significant difference. The p-value for the independent sample T-test was 0.014, indicating a difference between the two algorithms. Regarding the detection of tomato leaf disease, the Novel Visual Geometry Group 19 technique performed much better than the Artificial Neural Network approach. Overall, the method achieved a higher average accuracy.

articleTitle: Solar Powered Quazi-Z-Source Network Fed DC–DC Converter for Stand alone Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Due to higher dependability, efficiency, and reduced noise, BLDC motors are now favoured over brushed DC motors. Because of this high torque, cheap conservation, and the variable speed control, this is seen in every industry, including residential, industrial, automotive, and home uses. The benefits of a BLDC motor over a brushed DC motor include: Fast speed, a large power-to-size ratio, no arcing during commutation, a low moment of inertia, and faster acceleration; and armature winding attached to the stator, which makes this simple to transfer heat away via the winding. Because there is no brush-induced friction, BLDC motors are more effective than brushed D.C. motors. It is made up of a permanent magnet rotor, a three-phase stator winding, and an electronic controller with an inverter and converter. Through the inverter switches, input ac power is delivered to the stator winding in the proper phase sequence. In this proposed system, a modified voltage fed Quazi z source full bridge converter is developed. The model proposed system with both resistive and motor load. The BLDC motor drive is controlled for the constant speed operation, the closed loop PI control system to operate the motor in rated speed under loaded conditions.

articleTitle: Employee Engagement Prediction: A Comparative Study of Support Vector Machines and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Support Vector Machines (SVM) obtained higher performance than Neural Networks (NN). Accuracy and a number of other important metrics, NN defeated SVM (0.88 vs 0.85). The factors which are important in determining the level of engagement include job satisfaction, quality and competence of management as well able to get a good work-life balance etc. When looking at feature importance we can see this clearly. It is obvious from the fact that Neural Networks weigh job satisfaction and quality of leadership more heavily than other forms do, that they have a considerable impact on predictions. This study thus indicates that neural networks are very good at representing complicated patterns involving employee engagement, and can offer companies much information on the basis of which they may narrow down their choices about strategy.

articleTitle: Utilizing a Hybrid CNN-LSTM Model for Automated Severity Classification of Rice Panicle Blast Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Rice panicle blast is a globally prevalent and detrimental disease that impacts rice cultivation on a large scale. It poses a threat to both the quantity and quality of the rice they obtain. Our work proposes a novel approach utilizing a Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)-Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) deep learning (DL) model to accurately assess the severity of a rice panicle blast. This facilitates the resolution of the issue. This novel approach aims to overcome the limitations of traditional approaches to illness diagnosis. These methods are frequently incorrect and inefficient due to their requirement for extensive effort. For this research, we developed and meticulously trained a hybrid model utilizing a robust dataset of over 15,000 distinctly labeled images. These photographs depicted several stages and issues related to blast illness in rice panicles. Our model is unique due to its utilization of the salient features of CNN for spatial localization in images, and LSTM networks for efficient temporal information processing. This union creates a powerful tool for accurately categorizing illnesses. The CNN-LSTM model achieved a high accuracy rate of 97.97% in correctly predicting the severity of a disease within the range of one to five levels. The model maintained a consistently high level of accuracy, recall, and F1-score across all groups. This demonstrates the robustness and reliability of it. Our model surpasses traditional methods. It remains consistent and precise, demonstrating significant advancements in the field of agricultural disease categorization. This study not only provides an effective method for testing rice panicle blast, but also opens up new opportunities for the utilization of intelligent machinery in agriculture. This approach demonstrates the efficacy of DL techniques in enhancing disease management, resulting in increased agricultural yield and environmentally sustainable farming practices. Subsequent research endeavors may endeavor to employ this approach on a broader range of plant species and diseases. Utilizing advanced computer technologies will further enhance global agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Serial vs parallel execution of Principal Component Analysis using Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a crucial technique in data science and machine learning for reducing dimensionality and identifying crucial characteristics. But when dealing with big datasets, it uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), which is computationally costly. To address this issue, this study compares the effectiveness of parallel and serial PCA implementations. Serial execution uses a step-by-step data processing method, which is simple but falls short when dealing with large datasets. The task is divided across many processing units in parallel execution, which is preferred in high-performance computing environments, and thus results in significant speed increases for large datasets. While parallel execution shines with huge datasets and time-sensitive activities, serial execution improves with smaller datasets and simple scenarios. Depending on variables like dataset size and available computer resources, one of these techniques may be preferred over the other. In conclusion, this paper examines the advantages of utilizing parallel computing for PCA via SVD, offering a quick way to speed up calculations for high-dimensional datasets. It emphasizes how flexible it is to choose serial or parallel execution depending on the particular dataset's properties and processing needs.

articleTitle: Harnessing Quantum Systems for Simulating Complex Physical Phenomena
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This article describes how quantum systems can be used to replicate complex physical occurrences, with emphasis on the use of new quantum algorithms and special data sets. First, let's talk about how quantum computers can handle big and complex data sets that are too hard for classical computers. The focus here is on the use of quantum computing methods. The main focus of our school assignment is on developing and executing quantum algorithms specifically designed to analyze and evaluate these datasets. These quantum algorithm allows us to model a complex system. Explain the basic of tool that can be used to quantum material properties. Instructions: Change the word ‘formulas’ into another Word and rephrase the sentence accordingly. The study proposes using quantum algorithms to handle large data collections. We explain how to transform classical data to quantum representation for clearer comprehension. Also illustrated is how this encoding may yield simulated outcomes. This approach ensures precise and reliable simulations. Unlike ordinary data storage and correction, quantum computing presents various problem-solving obstacles. To remove these challenges, the simulation is made painstakingly precise and dependable. Case studies may show how quantum systems can simulate complicated situations like astronomical object motions and subatomic particle activity under harsh conditions. These case studies show that quantum simulation can address issues traditional approaches can't. Our findings might affect future study, and quantum computing could transform our knowledge of complex physical events. We also discuss quantum computing and coding's pros and cons, encouraging creative thinking in this fascinating topic.

articleTitle: Automated Bird Detection using using Snapshot Ensemble of Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A diverse variety of bird species are found in the earth. There are about 10,000 unique species of birds discovered so far. Identification and documentation of these birds, their migrating seasons, breeding seasons, food style, etc. requires effective monitoring. Identification of these birds is literally an impossible task for human without technological intervention. Hence deep learning models have been used which helps us in identification of the individual species of birds. In this scenario, it would be important to use an automated method to identify the species of birds. Several deep learning-based models for classifying and identifying bird species are evaluated in this study. These models are trained and tested on publicly available dataset. Snapshot images captured by the cameras are used as the major source of input data. The capability of deep learning models have been used to effectively identify the bird species individually. This study aims in developing a deep learning model using ensemble learning techniques that is capable of identification of individual bird species from a massive collection of input data images.

articleTitle: Design of Robotic Arm with Three Degree of Freedom (DOF) operated by Bluetooth enabled Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In 2022, the industrial sector contributed 29 percent of India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). On an average, approximately 340 million occupational accidents occur each year. This article is about the design of a robotic arm with three degrees of freedom, which is used for collecting and placing objects. A self-configuring, automated three-degree robotic arm that can assist the industrial sector in addressing the problem and preventing occupational accidents is proposed. To establish the wireless communication, HC 05 Bluetooth module is enabled to provide the product’s path and thereby reducing component damage. It consists mostly of three seals, a gripper, two shackles of rectangular shape, a rotating table and a rectangular platform. The angular rotation of each gasket is supplied with a DC motor. DC motors are used to power the robotic arm which generally increases the lift capacity and inexpensive when compared to the servomotors. The robotic arm design process involved a number of static and dynamic computations, mechanical properties computations and prototype trials to deliver an end product with well-established structure and functionality.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Human Heart Ailment using GridSearchCV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Nowadays, heart disease can affect most of the people in the world. ECG technology are used to estimate and diagnosis the heart diseases in the early days in the hospitals. Predicting this cardiac disease is a most challenging task in the medical field. Finding this problem will requires a lot of time and work. This paper deals with the different Machine learning techniques to detect and diagnosis the heart disease. In this project, we use Machine learning algorithms such as Logistic regression (LR), K-nearest neighbors (KNN), Support vector Machine (SVM) to predict and diagnosis the heart disease. As a result, it is simple to handle the patients more successfully and also on the other hand reduce the error. In this study, we work on the GridSearchCV technique to predicting the cardiac diseases and improving the accuracy of the predicted model. At last, we use evaluation metrics like precision, accuracy and recall for the above-mentioned Machine learning algorithms based on evaluation GridSearchCV to enhance the quality of the prediction of models which leads to more accurate detection of heart disease.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Monitoring and Seed Sowing Robot with ThingSpeak Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The increasing demand for efficient and sustainable agricultural practices has led to the development of advanced technologies in the field of precision agriculture. In this paper, the design of a Soil Moisture Monitoring and Seed Sowing Robot is proposed. This system helps to enhance the seed-sowing process in agricultural applications. This robotic system integrates the capabilities of the ESP32 microcontroller and servo motor to optimize the seed-sowing process. Additionally, it incorporates a moisture monitoring system to continuously assess soil moisture levels and send that data to ThingSpeak, ensuring optimal growing conditions. This paper highlights the design, implementation, and testing of the Smart Agriculture Seed Sowing Robot, featuring technical specifications, operational workflow, performance evaluation, and real-time soil moisture monitoring. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and potential impact of this robotic system in modern agriculture, paving the way for further advancements in precision farming techniques.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Transportation Infrastructure and Communication Technology through Blockchain and 5G Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents the outcomes of two key projects dedicated to the enhancement of modern transportation infrastructure and communication technology. The first project introduces a web-based application for toll tax collection, with a particular focus on bolstering security and transparency through the implementation of blockchain technology. By leveraging blockchain, this system successfully mitigates fraud and enhances accountability. Simultaneously, our second project utilizes the Open Air Interface for simulating 5G network node connections.The toll tax collection project yields substantial results by establishing a secure, decentralized platform through blockchain integration. This, in turn, leads to a notable reduction in fraud and a significant improvement in accountability. The system utilizes an immutable ledger and smart contracts to streamline toll collection processes, ultimately enhancing operational efficiency. In tandem, the 5G network simulation project contributes to the advancement of network technology, delivering improvements in efficiency, transparency, and user experience within toll collection systems, while also catalyzing the evolution of state-of-the-art communication infrastructure.

articleTitle: Optimizing User Satisfaction and Streamlining Operations in Online Retail Using CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The rising trend of online shopping has become increasingly prevalent in today's generation. With the convenience of browsing and purchasing products from the comfort of one's own home, it has reshaped the way people shop. In this digital age, having a dedicated shopping app has become a necessity for businesses looking to tap into this growing market. These apps offer seamless navigation, personalized recommendations, and secure payment options, catering to the preferences and expectations of today's tech-savvy consumers. As the world continues to embrace e-commerce, the need for user-friendly shopping apps remains essential for both consumers and businesses alike. Furthermore, this online shopping app incorporates advanced technologies, such as image recognition and augmented reality, to enhance the product exploration process. Customers can use their smartphones to scan product images or QR codes, allowing for a three-dimensional visualization of the chosen items and a deeper understanding of their features and assembly. Additionally, the app introduces a collaborative shopping feature that enables users to create shared wish lists and make group purchases, fostering social engagement and simplifying the gift-buying process. This innovative online shopping application not only caters to the evolving needs and preferences of modern consumers but also empowers retailers to offer a more immersive and efficient shopping experience. In a rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape, this app stands as a testament to the ongoing digital transformation of the retail industry.

articleTitle: AgriAid: An Intelligent Farmer Companion Using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The percentage of farmers in India’s enormous population is roughly 54.6%. However, despite having such a large population, they only contribute roughly 13.9% of the nation’s total yearly GDP. This severe inequality may be reduced by improving farmers’ access to information and expert advice. In order to increase crop output and quality, farmers typically depend on agricultural counselors and professionals to provide correct information for crop decision-making. Frequently, advisors or specialists in agriculture are not always available. A voice-based chatbot has several benefits, such as being real-time, constantly available, requiring little to no training to use, and providing instant access to information rather than requiring users to walk convoluted paths. In this study, we explain my design work for a farmer’s helper, named Farmer Companion, to meet the needs of both rural and urban Indian farmers utilizing Supervised ML Algorithms and Deep Neural Networks, of which the best one is selected. A comparison of recent models that have been used in the literature is also included in the paper.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Boosting Approach For Sonic Log Prediction Using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Sonic wave velocity is an important parameter in the oil and gas industry, as it provides crucial information about subsurface formations. The proposed method utilizes well logging data, specifically, the sonic log, which keeps track of how long a sound wave takes to navigate across the geological structures. Traditional methods for measuring sonic wave velocity involve drilling and core sample analysis, which can be time-consuming and expensive. Compressional transit time (DTC) and shear transit time (DTS) reports are not available for all wells drilled in the field due to resource constraints. In this situation, ML techniques can be used to predict compressional transit time and shear transit time data. Recently, non-invasive observations such as acoustic data from boreholes or seismic recordings have been used in conjunction with signal processing techniques to forecast sonic wave velocity. Wavelet Transformation, as one of the Signal Processing Techniques has been used to predict sonic logs, the process involves predicting using normal log data with the help of the XG boost model and then predicting it again once wavelet transformation has been done on the log data. Concerns regarding the accuracy and the amount of improvement were also addressed by comparing the two observations. The conclusion of this study can lead to sustainability in terms of sonic log prediction

articleTitle: Development and Application of a novel Improved Hybrid Multi Objective Black Widow Optimization Algorithm for optimization of a utility network connected hybrid system in view of Cost of Electrical Energy, Dependability, impact on atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Grid-connected hybrid systems functioning assessment is mostly based on the system’s cost, dependability, and ability to reduce infrared absorption gas (IRAG). A framework comprising a wind turbine (WTU) system, battery set, and a solar photovoltaic (PV) array coupled to a utility network has been modelled as well as subjected to multi-goal optimization. Here, the main target is the optimum decrease in the cost of electrical energy (COE) as well as loss of power supply probability (LPSP), along with incrementing renewable energy factor (REF) and achieving optimum IRAG. The hybrid framework’s yielded power was estimated using mathematical models of components. The outcomes demonstrated each system component’s contribution to the overall energy used to meet the electrical demand. The novelty of the paper lies in the development and application of a new hybrid algorithm which is named an improved hybrid multi-objective black widow optimization algorithm (IHMOBWOA) for the optimization of the system. The link between the suggested hybrid network and the grid was examined in terms of the system’s capacity to sell or purchase electricity from the suggested network. To examine this relationship, three scenarios were put forth. Here, the multi-objective (MO) based black widow optimization algorithm (MOBWOA), MO-based mantis search algorithm (MOMSA), and MO-based coati optimization algorithm (MOCOA) are all contrasted with the suggested technique for assessing the performance of the suggested methodology.

articleTitle: Smart Detection of Rose Rust Using CNN-Random Forest Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study delivers a thorough assessment of a categorization model's performance over a range of "Profundity levels," each of which denotes a distinct degree of severity for a given disease. The efficacy of the model is revealed by the metrics that have been displayed, including Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Support, Support Proportion, and Accuracy. The model exhibits a remarkable Precision of 95.24% with "Profundity level 1," indicating that it can produce reliable accurate forecasts within this class. With a recall score of 90.91%, it can accurately recognize a substantial percentage of favourable events. The precision and recall-averaging F1-Score is 93.02%, indicating strong overall results for this particular class. The context for the amount of data is provided by the Encourage value of 1100 instances, and the Support Proportion, at 0.17, shows the proportional representation of the data in the dataset. Furthermore, the model's high accuracy of 98% highlights how well it can classify examples with "Profundity level 1." With "Profundity levels 2 as well as 3," similarly excellent outcomes have been observed with both groups exhibiting excellent Precision, recall. F1-Scores, and Accuracy. The algorithm consistently produces accurate predictions during the move towards greater "Profundity levels," albeit with a few minor changes. A summary of the accuracy of the model is given by the "Macro Average" row, which displays a standard F1-Score of 92.26, an average Precision of 92.47%, and an annual Recall of 92.09%. The balanced performance in all "Profundity levels" is represented by these values. Taking into account the different class sizes, the "Weighted Average" column also shows the overall performance of the model. As evidenced by the model's averaged accuracy, recollection, and F1-score of 92.26, 92.19, as well as 92.20, correspondingly, it is evident that the dataset is consistently accurate. The model's robustness for forecasting severity levels in the study is statistically demonstrated by the remarkable overall Accuracy of 92.194, while the "Micro Minimum" Accuracy of 92.19 highlights the model's reliable and precise categorization of incidents across all classes.

articleTitle: Cervical Cancer Classification: Optimizing Accuracy, Precision, and Recall using SMOTE Preprocessing and t-SNE Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Machine Learning(ML) algorithms are used in cervical cancer categorization to determine whether a person has cervical cancer based on pertinent information from medical records. This procedure is critical in healthcare for prior treatment. For this kind of categorization problem, many ML approaches such as RF(Random Forest), SVM(Support Vector Machine), and LR(Logistic Regression) can be used. We employed ML techniques to increase the accuracy, precision, and recall of cervical cancer diagnosis in this study. SMOTE preprocessing was used to resolve data imbalance by producing synthetic samples for the minority class. Furthermore, t-SNE feature extraction was used to capture complex structures in the data. SVM consistently outperforms RF and Logistic Regression when combined with SMOTE preprocessing and t-SNE feature extraction, demonstrating improved accuracy, precision, and recall rates. This research highlights the efficacy of these strategies in enhancing cervical cancer categorization, indicating the possibilities for precise and reliable forecasting in medical investigations. The proposed SVM gave accuracy of 92.60%, precision of 0.91 and recall of 0.90 respectively. The tool used for execution is python.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Long term Renal disease using Machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Long term renal Ailment[LRA] is sometimes referred as Long-term Renal Ailment is a prolonging Ailment that is accountable for affecting more than 10% of the world population. On an average it is responsible for affecting nearly 800 million people globally every year. Early detection and diagnosis play a crucial role in reducing the complications of the Ailment.
