Various machine learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree and Extreme Gradient Boosting with Multi class categorization have been used and the best algorithm is then used to develop the model which is capable of predicting the long term renal Ailment using image pro0cessing. For feature selection, cross-validation recursive feature removal and analysis of variance have been used.

articleTitle: Comparison of Digital Image Watermarking using Hybrid DWT-DCT Algorithm with Fuzzy-Based Algorithm for Improving PSNR
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Comparing the Fuzzy-Based method with a Hybrid DWT-DCT method, the purpose of this study is to enhance the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio for Digital Image Watermarking. This will be accomplished by employing the hybrid algorithm. For the purpose of conducting a comparative study of digital picture watermarking, a new hybrid DWT-DCT method is used. Group 1 and group 2 are both fuzzy-based algorithms, and each group contains ten samples (n = 10) for the purpose of the analysis. Changing the variables that are entered enables this job to be carried out. The G power test has a value of around 80% (the parameters for the G power setting are α=0.05 and power=0.80). Compared to the fuzzy-based method, which has a PSNR of 97.01 dB, the unique hybrid DWT-DCT algorithm has a higher PSNR of 99.23 dB, and it has a significance value of 0.001 (two-tailed, p<0.05). Comparatively speaking, the power spectrum noise ratio (PSNR) of the new Hybrid DWT-DCT method is higher than the PSNR of the fuzzy-based algorithms.

articleTitle: Implementing Various Systems with DevOps to Make Successful Decisions based on Intelligent Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Software companies are under intense pressure to provide high-quality software on schedule as a result of a number of causes, including the fast evolution of technology, shifting consumer preferences, and shifting business fashions. To address this challenge, the software business is always searching the answer to enhance processing timing. Among businesses in the United States today, Development and Operations (DevOps) has become increasingly popular due to the perceived benefits it offers. However, several challenges arise for businesses when they try to implement DevOps procedures. The purpose of this study is to determine what aspects of the DevOps process may be strengthened via further investigation. In order to complete this study, we first perform a comprehensive literature analysis to determine which elements positively affect DevOps. Software developers today may continue to enhance their expertise to be ready for the next DevOps step, via growth, delivery, and quality assurance. Leaders of any team, however, should be as ready to face down formidable obstacles. DevOps has matured and gained popularity over time. The proliferation of mobile phones has further accelerated this pattern. Increased collaboration and automation have allowed the DevOps cycle to flourish, allowing developers to more rapidly develop, test, and deliver their programmes. DevOps will remain prominent in the United States, where constant updates are revolutionizing the delivery of software to a practically infinite consumer base. Many industry watchers believe that 2018 is the year that DevOps will finally reach its full potential and become the industry norm. To demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach, this paper introduces a new learning strategy, the Intelligent Learning Strategy for Novel Decision Making (ILSNDM), which will be cross-validated against a more traditional learning scheme, the Artificial Neural Network (ANN).

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of Scalable Multiply and Accumulate Architectures in DSP: A Comparative Study of LUT Based and LUT-Less Based Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Multiply and Accumulate (MAC) units are widely used in digital signal processing. They are crucial for activities like correlation, convolution, and filtering, which allow for fast and effective signal processing. A fundamental component in modern digital signal processing systems, these scalable units serve as the foundation for a wide variety of DSP algorithms. The distributed arithmetic method, which offers reduced computational complexity while preserving accuracy through parallelism and distributed multiplication operations, is a highly effective way for creating Multiply and Accumulate (MAC) structures in digital signal processing. A scalable Multiply and Accumulate (MAC) architectures are shown in this article. Also, explored the design of multiply and accumulate structures at various bit-widths: 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64-bit versions, as well as analyzed LUT-based and LUT-less approaches. Significant variations in space and power consumption between LUT-based and LUT-less systems are highlighted by the data in the article for a variety of bit-width configurations. A quantitative examination shows that whereas LUT-less devices continue to have a smaller footprint and lower power consumption even on larger bit-widths, LUT-based solutions clearly consume large area and consumes more power as width of the bits expands. The proposed method is designed and simulated using Xilinx Vivado 2022.2 software.

articleTitle: A Double-band Antenna of Microstrip Feature with Dual Rectangular Step-slots for Application in Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this work, a dual-band antenna of microstrip in nature for usage in the domain of wireless communication is proposed. The band-dual characteristics in the final designed antenna are generated by etching out two rectangular step-slots. Slots are symmetrical in nature from the edges of sides which are non-radiating in nature. The developed antenna shows resonance at 1.86 and 2.40 GHz center frequency. The antenna that is developed here provides the flat and consistent gain profiles of 1.64 dBi and 1.65 dBi at the two resonance bands. Apart from this, the developed antenna here demonstrates the flat, appropriate and adequate efficiencies of 86% at the two resonance bands. The proposed antenna provides stable, consistent, and appropriate radiation patterns which enable it to be appropriately used in the wireless domains of PCS and WLAN respectively.

articleTitle: A Secure Data Encryption Mechanism in Cloud Using Elliptic Curve Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Cloud computing is undergoing continuous evolution and is widely regarded as the next generation architecture for computing. Cloud computing technology allows users to store their data and applications on a remote server infrastructure known as the cloud. Cloud service providers, such Amazon, Rackspace, VMware, iCloud, Dropbox, Google's Application, and Microsoft Azure, provide customers the opportunity to create and deploy their own applications inside a cloud-based environment. These providers also grant users the ability to access and use these applications from any location worldwide. The subject of security poses significant challenges in contemporary times. The primary objective of cloud security is to establish a sense of confidence between cloud service providers and data owners inside the cloud environment. The cloud service provider is responsible for ensuring user data's security and integrity. Therefore, the use of several encryption techniques may effectively ensure cloud security. Data encryption is a commonly used procedure utilised to ensure the security of data. This study analyses the Elliptic Curve Cryptography method, focusing on its implementation in the context of encryption and digital signature processes. The objective is to enhance the security of cloud applications. Elliptic curve cryptography is a very effective and robust encryption system due to its ability to provide reduced key sizes, decreased CPU time requirements, and lower memory utilisation.

articleTitle: Corporate Feed Antenna Array for mmWave Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The next-generation wireless communication promises to offer enhanced services that includes of higher data rate, better connectivity, and low latency. Since the 4GLTE spectrum is occupied, there is a need to shift towards higher frequency. The mmWave band is idle not much occupied and also offers high bandwidth, but has a disadvantage of signal attenuation. One essential part for wireless communication system is an antenna. A high gain antenna will be a critical requirement for mmWave communication. The single microstrip patch antenna is firstly designed to resonate at 24GHz. The gain offered by single antenna is not encourage, for mmWave application, the enhancement in gain is obtained with antenna array. The feed technique used is the corporate feed. The basic advantage of corporate feed is it occupies less space and more antenna can be accommodated on the substrate. The antenna linear array of 1x2 and 1x4 is constructed using the corporate feed technique. The improvement in gain and bandwidth of the antenna of 12.98dB and 2.3GHz are achieved with a 1x4 corporate feed antenna array. Thus, the proposed, 1x4 array is more suitable candidate for mmWave application.

articleTitle: Image-Based Cognitive States Identification through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Yoga and mindfulness practices offer a variety of benefits, promoting both physical and mental well-being. This research intersects with AI, psychology, neuroscience, and more within cognitive science, contributing to the study of the brain, mind, memory, and disorders. The study presents a novel approach utilizing deep learning and image classification techniques to distinguish practitioners from non-practitioners of yoga based on pre-processed data. Data pre-processing involves down sampling, filtering, and Independent Component Analysis (ICA) to enhance the extraction of relevant features. The pre-processed data is transformed into images using Gramian Angular Field, facilitating the utilization of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models. The proposed methodology leverages custom-built CNN models to classify individuals into their respective groups. The models are trained on the image representations of the pre-processed data, enabling the extraction of intricate patterns and features for accurate classification.

articleTitle: Heuristic Methods for Fetal Contour Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Accurate segmentation of fetal anatomy in ultrasound images is critical for prenatal screening and diagnosis. However, inherent limitations of ultrasound imaging like speckle noise, occlusion, and low contrast obscure finer anatomical detail and pose challenges for traditional segmentation techniques. This paper examines heuristic methods leveraging a priori knowledge to improve fetal contour extraction from ultrasound data. Techniques including active contours, Canny edge detection, morphological operations, and connected component labeling are evaluated on a dataset of fetal scan images. However, results demonstrate the inability of these standard algorithms to reliably segment fetal anatomy due to artifacts and variability in ultrasound images. The active contour model struggles with smaller features while Canny detection produces excessive false edges. Morphological operations distort object shape and connected component labeling cannot differentiate finer boundaries. Overall, findings reveal the need for specialized algorithms incorporating domain knowledge of imaging physics and anatomical structure to enable robust fetal segmentation. Advancing ultrasound fetal contour extraction requires innovative techniques designed specifically for the modality’s challenges. Reliable segmentation could assist clinicians in measuring anatomical development to detect potential abnormalities.

articleTitle: Design & Development of an Automated Wheelchair for differently abled person using Keypad & Bluetooth Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the design and development of a low-cost automated wheelchair for the patient or patient attender or differently abled person. The entire system is designed based on 24 V operating voltage. The various components/modules such as Permanent Magnet DC motors (PMDC motor), linear actuators, H bridge DC-DC chopper, DC voltage regulator, Microcontroller, keypad, and Bluetooth modules are selected as per the design. An eight-channel relay module is used as an H bridge circuit for linear actuator movements in order to move the left leg footrest, right leg footrest, and back supporting rest independently. Simulation of four quadrant chopper is carried out with an equivalent PMDC motor load to analyze the electrical parameters such as switching pulses, voltage across motor & current drawn by the motor using the MATLAB/Simulink software package. The hardware modules are mounted on the wheelchair and coupled to two PMDC motors and six linear actuators. The input voltage across the motor and current drawn by the motor are recorded using a power quality analyzer HIOKI PW3198 model. The waveforms and results obtained from the simulation of the power converter are in conformation with the hardware results obtained. The navigation mode, left leg footrest, right leg footrest movements, and reclining of the wheelchair are tested independently by using a switch selector to choose either keypad mode or Bluetooth mode and found to be successful with respect to the features considered for the design of the automated wheelchair.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Approaches for Early Prediction of Depression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Depression is a widespread and incapacitating mental health illness which continues to pose problems for the world's healthcare systems. Effective therapy depends on prompt discovery and intervention, yet the difficulty of detecting depression frequently results in underdiagnosis and undertreatment. In this study, a thorough overview of the use of machine learning (ML) models for accurate depression diagnosis is provided. The primary goal of this research is to improve early diagnosis, risk assessment, and patient care in the field of depression detection utilizing predictive models. For this purpose, the Depression Prediction dataset available on Kaggle was utilized, and ten different ML models were employed. The results showed that Random Forest outperformed the rest of the models by achieving 98.22% accuracy while Ensemble method obtained 0.98 F1-score.

articleTitle: A Survey on the usage of numerous ML Models for agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Machine Learning has proved that it has the potential to tremendously increase crop production along with quality by providing insight into the required data. Machine Learning has ensured more accuracy by enabling farmers individually to make decisions related to farming. Machine Learning impacts the efficacy of crop classification and quality, agrochemical production, detection of plant diseases, and prevention of it. Deep learning algorithms can process an enormous amount of raw field data such as how crops have performed in different climates, and how they have inherited certain traits, and this information can be utilized to create a probability model. With such information, machine learning can predict the most beneficial breed. Machine learning is more systematic and helps in making precise decisions. This paper discusses a comprehensive survey on how different authors have adopted Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms along with insight of agriculture techniques for better results.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Systematic Animal Classification System using Advanced Deep Learning Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a system for automatically identifying images of animals are offered. To begin, the background of the image is removed by segmentation using an exponential incision based approach. After an animal picture has been segmented, it is divided into a number of blocks such that the colour texture moments may be recovered independently from each block. The threats that animals face now are far higher than they were in the past. In this study, we offer a suite of algorithms for animal categorization and detection across a range of visual modalities, with potential applications in the realm of animal conservation. In this paper, we propose a new animal classification principle, the Semantic Learning Principle for Animal Classification (SLPAC), and compare its performance to that of a more conventional deep learning algorithm, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The suggested technique has broad applications in the field of object identification and picture categorization. In addition, two statistical studies are provided to provide light on the animal categorization system’s prediction behaviour. These tests probe the indicators that cause the system to settle on a certain option. Statistical hypothesis testing shows that the input image including an animal has a substantial impact on the system’s final verdict. The resultant part displays the performance of the suggested technique in clear manner with graphical demonstrations.

Author Keywords: Semantic Learning Principle for Animal Classification

articleTitle: Attribute Selection Model using Meta Classifiers for Pneumonia Diagnosis System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Pneumonia which is caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome. It is also one of the worst pandemics in recent history. Identification of pneumonia affected patients or suspected patients is becoming very crucial nowadays. The proposed article is to trained and test a machine learning model to detect pneumonia based on chest X-ray images. The model built using machine learning algorithms like Meta classifiers are trained on the data sets containing more than 5863 chest X-ray images composed of two categories as pneumonia affected and normal patients. X ray images are the anterior and posterior images that are selected from the longitudinal reviews from patients of 1 to 5 years old from Guangzhou women and children’s Medical Centre. The test x-ray performed as the part of patience routine clinical care during this covid-19. The Proposed system of Pneumonia detection is done with and without attribute selection methodology. A clear analytical system is formed by building a model using some predefined Meta classifiers using machine learning algorithms. Algorithms used are Bagging, AdaBoost, LogitBoost, and Random Committee and Random Subspace algorithms. The accuracy of the built model obtained during the classification process is 89.27% for bagging algorithm and the receiver operator characteristics for all the above mention classifiers is greater than 0.9. The performance of the selected Meta classifiers accuracy level of the classification after selecting the attributes lies from 84.819% to 88.9354% for Ada Boost and Random subspace classifiers.

articleTitle: Bowling action recognition using computer vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the realm of computer vision with respect to cricket domain, object tracking with precise pose prediction has proven to be difficult and hence less work is found in this region. Object detection is different from such applications, as used for identifying the type of object present, while the task of tracking and identifying the unique identity of the specific object which is detected is one of the main objectives. Object tracking technology has been found to have a wide spectrum of applications in the sports industry and can be used to identify different types of athletes based on their unique characteristics of action performed while bowling. This study focuses on identifying cricket players and distinguishing between bowling and non-bowling actions based on the various poses they adopt while playing the game. Yolo V3 is the object detection system, here it is used to detect cricket players while MoveNet lightning is used for the detection of keypoints of the individual. The CNN acts as a classification model, which is designed for the classification of action, which is identifying each athletes pose and enabling more accurate classification of bowling or non-bowling action.

articleTitle: Detection Of Image Forgery Using Error Level Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Image forging is the manipulation of digital images using methods like copy-move, splicing, image removal etc. This paper provides an overview of the system’s architecture, highlighting the integration of digital image processing, OpenCV, and machine learning algorithms Image forgery detection is the process of identifying a modified image from the original. In the realm of digital image processing, image forgery detection is a critical task. The amount of altered and faked photographs has increased as digital imaging has become more prevalent and is used in a variety of fields, including forensics, media, and scientific study. They must guard the veracity of photos and stop the dissemination of false information and fake news. The detection of picture forgeries, however, is fraught with technological difficulties, including the requirement for reliable and accurate image features, the capacity to differentiate between various types of image alteration, and effective algorithms that can analyze enormous quantities of digital images. To meet these problems, the error level analysis image processing technique and convolutional neural network are used to create a model that can predict the input images as forged ad unforged. The proposed model shows a better performance by giving an accuracy of 87%.

articleTitle: Application of Scrum framework and Low Code No Code platform for development and implementation of In-patient electronic visitor management system to optimise hospital operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study focuses on the development of an Electronic Visitor Management System for small-scale hospitals, utilizing an Agile-based Scrum Framework and a Low No-Code (Low Code No Code) platform. The primary aim is to address the challenges of managing crowds and footfalls in hospital in-patient departments (IPD) efficiently. The methodology employed for this project involved the use of the mHealth agile framework, combining clinical product development stages with agile development. A Scrum team was formed, and a comprehensive project timeline was established, with a series of sprints, each with its specific goals and associated product backlog items. The development tools utilized included the Zoho Low Code No Code platform, SQL database, and Android Studio for publishing the application. Results from each sprint are discussed, ranging from defining the project scope to releasing the successful application. The study emphasizes the importance of user consultation for enhancing the User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) of the application. Feedback from stakeholders and end-users played a crucial role in refining the product. Overall, this study showcases the successful development of an Electronic Visitor Management System for hospitals, highlighting the role of technology and healthcare professionals in digital health initiatives, reducing development time and costs.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Strategies for Identifying and Classifying Mango Scab Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Mango Scab Disease, caused by Elsinoë mangiferae fungus, is a big problem for growing mangoes around the world. Old ways of finding out about diseases, mostly done by hand, can't keep up with how complex and different they are. This study presents a new way to find Mango Scab Disease using an innovative system that uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) together. This research wants to put the sickness into six different groups using a picture set of 5,000 mango scab images. The process includes cleaning the data, finding features with CNN, and then classifying using SVM. The hybrid model uses CNN's skill for easy feature picking and SVM's power for incorrect sorting. The model’s efficient performance, with an overall accuracy of 92.86%. The model showed its strength and accuracy by correctly classifying different levels of disease seriousness. The side-by-side check showed that the hybrid model is better than other models for how well it could classify disease seriousness and its speed. This study's results are important for improving the ways we find and handle farming diseases. The combined CNN-SVM model not only makes disease classification more accurate, but it's also a flexible and fast solution. This could change how we manage diseases in mango farming for the better. The way this study was done and its results can help future studies using deep learning (DL) methods to solve other farming problems.

articleTitle: Implementation of a 32-bit MAC unit in AISC flow using Vedic Multiplier and CSA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper majorly focuses on the developing an IP i.e., a 32-bit MAC in Verilog HDL using Vedic multiplier along with CSA and implementation of design using ASIC flow. This is a combinational circuit designed through a hierarchical approach, promoting modular and scalable architectures, reducing redesigns and integration time. An ancient Vedic principles-based Multiplier is used with a Carry Save Adder which will reduce the complexities to keep the design simpler and efficient. The simulation of the MAC unit is performed in Cadence Xcelium. The key differentiator of this unit is that it is implemented using ASIC flow on Cadence tools like Genus and Innovus which is the physical design process using the technology library of 45nm. There is an effective execution of floor planning which is crucial to minimize the physical layout's overall area and optimal use of power. There was detailed analysis conducted to obtain better results on the previously published similar designs. In the physical design implementation process the MAC unit is synthesized and floorplanning is performed along with placement of the design. Further routing is performed to ensure physical connections between the gates are created while minimizing total wirelength, meeting timing requirements, and avoiding violations of design rules.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis for Products Review based on NLP using Lexicon-Based Approach and Roberta
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is also often mentioned as opinion mining, it is a part of natural language processing technique to predict or perform research by considering the sentiment or emotional tone indicated in a written document—like a product review—is ascertained. It is used to understand whether the author of the review has a positive, negative, or neutral opinion about the product or service they are discussing. Businesses and organizations can use sentiment analysis as a useful tool to determine areas for improvement, measure consumer happiness, and make data-driven choices. This study seeks to add to the ongoing conversation in the field of NLP. It is intended to provide useful insights for academics wanting to investigate the varied field of sentiment analysis, professionals hoping to use consumer sentiment to inform strategy, and companies hoping to succeed in the fast-paced environment of the online market. The research presented here highlights the crucial part sentiment analysis plays in contemporary business and consumer decision-making processes by using Vader and Roberta. Roberta outperformed over Vader and the accuracy was around 91%.

articleTitle: Email Protection in the Digital Age: Evaluating Symmetric Cryptographic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Nowadays, digital data interaction plays an increasingly pivotal role across various industries. Ensuring the security of information during data storage and transmission is of paramount importance. Cryptography serves as a formidable guardian when it comes to safeguarding multimedia data, encompassing audio, video, images, and more, during its journey through networks. By employing a diverse range of cryptographic algorithms, data is encrypted before transmission and decrypted upon reception. Among these algorithms, Data Encryption Standard (DES), Triple Data Encryption Standard (3DES), and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) are some of the most widely recognized algorithms. The performance and security properties of DES, 3DES, and AES are analyzed and compared in this paper. The performance and effectiveness of these encryption algorithms are examined based on individual strengths and shortcomings. The findings of this paper contribute valuable insights into selecting the most suitable encryption algorithm for email protection, enhancing the overall security posture of digital communications.

articleTitle: Review on Augmented Reality in Civil Engineering Education and Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) stands at the forefront of technological advancements, reshaping the way we perceive and interact with our environment. This paper delves deeply into the multifaceted applications of AR, emphasizing its transformative impact on the education sector and engineering disciplines. In education, AR transcends traditional learning paradigms, offering immersive experiences that merge digital content with the tangible world. This fusion not only demystifies complex concepts but also fosters heightened student engagement and tailored learning experiences. Shifting the lens to engineering, especially civil engineering, AR emerges as a game-changer. It provides engineers and architects with tools to visualize prospective structures in their actual environments, enhancing design accuracy and stakeholder communication. On construction sites, AR overlays crucial data, from subterranean utilities to geological specifics, ensuring precision and efficiency. Furthermore, AR’s integration facilitates real-time monitoring, safety training, and public engagement, streamlining processes and minimizing potential errors. As AR continues to evolve, its potential to revolutionize sectors, from education to civil engineering, becomes increasingly evident. This paper underscores the pivotal role of AR in shaping future innovations, emphasizing its capacity to bridge the digital and physical realms seamlessly.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Time Series Forecasting Methods in Workforce Planning using Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This study compares three approaches of labor force forecasting namely, ARIMA, Exponential smoothing, LSTM. In this regard, this is evidence that ARIMA has more accuracy and stability, having RMSE = 0.025 and MAE = 0.015. According to exponential smoothing results, there is an acceptable balance between precision and reliability which have RMSE value of 0.90 and MAE value of 0.18 severally. While this introduces some complexity in the model, the LSTM can readily identify complex patterns with just about 0.035 standard error to the mean and an average mistake size of just about 0.022. The strength of ARIMA and LSTM against economic indicators, as well as Exponential Smoothing’s sensitivity to industry trends. From the point of view of validation, the models were generally acceptable; ARIMA exhibited stability but Exponential Smoothing brought about flexibility. Through such an insight, organizations can use information for making wise decisions by choosing a certain type of strategy basing on specific priorities for the company, dynamics within this industry or field, as well as right balance that may be required while planning for workforce.

articleTitle: A Composite Approach for a Multi-Layer Perceptron Implementation of Digital Predistortion in Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Power Amplifier performance is critical to the operation of any wireless communication. Since it is the front end of any transmitter or receiver, poor PA performance can cause spill over in the adjacent channels, which in turn may increase the operating costs for the cellular operators. The main cause for the poor performance of the PA is the inherent nonlinearity, which is taken care by introducing a digital predistortion (DPD). Traditionally the DPD is implemented before the PA block using polynomial method, which can be time consuming. In this work, a hybrid method for DPD is implemented using a neural network with feedback. Because of this feedback, the weights of the NN- DPD change in accordance with the change in the PA characterization and hence dynamic in nature. This adaptable structure is suitable for PAs used in 5G wireless systems. It is found that the performance improved in terms of Error Vector Magnitude NMSE and ACPR.

articleTitle: Accurate Prediction of Bacterial Infections using Deep Learning-Based Approaches: A Recent Study and Progress
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Bacterial diseases cause a major threat to the health globally which necessitates to its accurate detection as well as diagnosis. There are various traditional methods like clinical assessments, laboratory techniques, microbiological tests etc which no doubt are effective but consumes a lot of time and relies completely on experienced professionals for validation. Hence, to address such challenges, deep learning models have been termed as game changers as they are capable of analysing the data rapidly, diagnosing the patient on time, and minimizing the human errors. This manuscript provides complete information related to the techniques which have been used for the detection and classification of bacterial diseases. It commences with a concise introduction to bacterial diseases and an exploration of conventional diagnostic methods. Subsequently, it delves into the transformative impact of deep learning models on disease detection and classification. The work of researchers in this domain is examined and compared by highlighting their limitations, which serve as the foundation for the proposed system. In essence, this manuscript offers a detailed examination of research papers that leverage such AI learning models for bacterial disease detection and classification, paving the way for more efficient and accurate healthcare practices.

articleTitle: LiDAR-Equipped Speed Bump Alert System: Pioneering Safety Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Speed breakers in India are usually ambiguous, with no adequate indication or sign boards to signify them. Drivers are distracted by the frequent deployment of speed breakers on domestic routes. Furthermore, drivers frequently fail to recognize the sight of unsigned speed breakers and lose control of their vehicles, resulting in major accidents and fatalities. There are a few approaches in the literature to alert on-road drivers of oncoming speed breakers, but they are prone to error and demand time. Furthermore, none focus on tracking the information of violating speed breakers. In this research, we propose a system for automatic dynamic speed breaker detection and warning generation for drivers. The suggested method incorporates early detection of speed breakers utilizing a TF-Mini Micro LiDAR sensor to alert vehicles to the presence of speed breakers on rural and urban roadways. A LiDAR sensor is used to measure distance in the most effective way possible. The sensor detects and measures distance using light beams. Using sensors resulted in a high degree of precision in detecting road obstructions. Other unknown obstacles on the road may also frighten the driver. The appearance of speed breakers is brought to the driver's attention so that accidents can be reduced on a much larger scale. The automobile can be protected against harm by informing the driver of the speed breakers.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Object Detection System for Crowd Monitoring in High-Security Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In order to maintain crowd control and assure safety, contemporary security systems require effective monitoring tools for sensitive and high-traffic locations. In particular, headcount estimate in sensitive areas like high-security buildings, crowded areas is the subject of this research’s novel using deep learning algorithms for real-time object identification in surveillance settings. The main goal is to create a reliable system that can count the number of people in a certain area, recognize their presence, and sound an alarm when the number of people in the crowd rises over pre-established levels. YOLO (You Only Look Once), RetinaNet, SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector), and RCNN (Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks) are four of the cutting-edge deep learning models that are applied in this study of object recognition. In order to identify the best method for precise and effective headcount estimation, the study comprises a comparison review of various models. And of all the models examined, YOLO consistently showed the greatest results for precision, recall, and average precision, making it the most efficient model for this specific project.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Low-Power Comparator for a 10-Bit Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) for General-Purpose Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Analog-to-digital converters play a pivotal role in signal processing, especially in applications demanding low power consumption and extended battery life. Among the various ADC architectures, the Successive Approximation Register (SAR) ADC is particularly effective for applications requiring low power, moderate resolution, and moderate speed. In this study, we present an enhanced design of a dynamic latch comparator that maintains area efficiency while significantly reducing power consumption. The modified dynamic latch-based comparator was meticulously designed and simulated using LTSpice, resulting in a circuit that consumes less power. This comparator consists of two distinct stages: a dynamic differential input gain stage and an output latch. The suggested circuit was implemented using a 180 nm standard technology and optimized for SAR-ADCs operating at a 5V supply voltage. Our enhanced design strikes a balance between area efficiency and power efficiency, making it an ideal choice for low-power applications.

articleTitle: Optimizing Agricultural Productivity: A Data-Driven Ensemble Model for Crop Recommendation Based on Site-Specific Characteristics and Weather Conditions in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: India’s economy and employment are significantly impacted by agriculture. Indian farmers frequently make the mistake of selecting the incorrect crop for the characteristics of their land. The effect is a decrease in productivity. Careful crop selection is necessary for farmers to provide high-quality harvests. We have discovered a solution to the farmers’ dilemma. Here, we introduce an ensemble model that uses a majority voting approach recommendation system to provide extremely precise crop recommendations for parameters unique to each site, such as soil nutrients (nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and pH level) and local weather conditions (temperature, humidity, and rainfall). The methods we use to do this include Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors, and Naive Bayes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Fidelity through Denoising and Style GAN Techniques with Serial and Parallel Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research proposes an approach to enhance the denoising and upscaling performance of noisy images using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), particularly Style GAN architecture. Denoising and upscaling noisy images are crucial in many computer vision applications, and GANs have shown remarkable effectiveness in creating high-quality images. However, training Style GAN requires huge amount of data and is computationally expensive. To address this issue, this study proposes using various filters such as mean, median, and weighted median to pre-process the noisy images before feeding them to Style GAN. The proposed approach achieves superior denoising and upscaling compared with other system in terms of FID and inception score, and further exploration of hyperparameters and variations of the Style GAN architecture can lead to even better results.

articleTitle: State space modelling and seamless transition between Islanded and Grid-connected operation modes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Three Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) based distributed renewable sources are considered in a microgrid (MG). This research is important for developing more reliable and resilient power systems, specifically by investigating the transient behaviour of VSI frequency and voltage under sudden changes, to ensure an uninterruptible supply of power to critical loads. A smooth transfer from islanded (IS) mode to grid-connected (GC) mode is necessary to provide higher reliability when excess power is needed in the isolated network or vice versa. The key objective of this research is to evaluate how sudden load fluctuations at particular distributed generation (DG) units affect the MG when it’s operating in IS mode. To accomplish this, we introduce a state-space model for analyzing MG stability. We also investigate the transition from IS mode to GC mode to ensure a smooth and stable progression. This modelling approach significantly enhances the practical reliability and efficiency of MGs. The case study has been realized through implementation in the MATLAB/SIMULINK with m-file to observe the MG and grid stability under transient conditions.

articleTitle: Automatic Smart Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This work introduces an independent smart irrigation setup employing NodeMCU and IFTTT. Through sensors monitoring soil moisture, temperature, and humidity, it manages irrigation by controlling a water pump and solenoid valves. Integration with IFTTT allows scheduling and notifications for remote accessibility. The system's primary objective is to conserve water while ensuring optimal soil moisture levels, fostering agricultural benefits such as increased crop yield, reduced costs, and sustainable practices. Operating between 9 to 12 volts DC, it utilizes soil probes to gauge moisture content. Upon detecting insufficient moisture, the NodeMCU triggers the relay, activating the pump to irrigate the crops. This innovation minimizes manual labor, enhances water efficiency, and proves economically viable.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Optimized Clear Channel Assessment for Data Transmission in IEEE 802.15.4 based Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In current applications such as smart cities, smart grids, and industrial wireless sensor networks, the Internet of Things (IoT) plays a major role to build many wireless sensor network (WSN) applications. To develop such applications, the primary requirement is to develop a stable short-range enabled WSN. Furthermore, the IEEE 802.15.4 standard establishes a short-range reliable communication between the devices in WSN. However, the clear channel assessment (CCA) adopted in the standard is not suitable for all the network scenarios. In this paper, we develop an optimized CCA algorithm for the recurrent data transmitted in the star topology networks. Furthermore, the optimized CCA is analyzed with Markov chain model and validated using the MATLAB 2019a Tool.

articleTitle: The Nanoscale Technology and Photovoltaics Convergence: A Detailed Analysis of the Quantum Leap Achieved by Silver Nanoparticle Incorporation into SiO2 Non- -reflective Coatings for Solar Cell Efficiency Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The effectiveness of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> solar cell coatings in reducing reflection, both with and without the presence of silver nanoparticles, was the primary focus of this study. Various parameters of single-link layer photovoltaic (PV) cells, including the thickness of the protective front layer and the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> antireflective coatings with or without silver nanoparticles, were analysed through simulations conducted using the photovoltaic QCRF-FDTD simulator. The simulation outcomes revealed that the PV cell parameters exhibited a noticeable increase with varying thicknesses of the protective front layer composed of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, reaching a maximum value of 150 nm in both scenarios. Furthermore, the addition of silver nanoparticles contributed to enhanced efficiency in the PV cell, reaching a peak of 19.75%, while without nanoparticles, the efficiency reached up to 19.48%. These findings underscore the potential of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> antireflective coatings, along with the inclusion of silver nanoparticles, to enhance the efficiency of PV cells. This research holds promise for future advancements in solar cell technology.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effectiveness of Recurrent Neural Networks for Network Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Network security has assumed utmost significance in today's highly linked world, where enterprises face more complex cyber threats. A key role in detecting and mitigating these threats is played by network anomaly detection, which flags odd patterns and behaviors in network data. Traditional anomaly detection techniques, overburdened with having to cope with constantly shifting threats, have inspired a search for machine learning tools like Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). This paper aims at exploring how well Recurrent Neural Networks perform in the field of computer network-anomaly detection. We plan a complete analysis to compare the efficacy of RNN-based models against traditional methods like statistical techniques and simple neural networks, based on an extensive set of network traffic. In the collection are both normal network traffic and malicious intrusions. Our experiments indicate that RNNs have great potential for finding anomalies in networks. Models such as these can make use of the sequential dependencies existing in network traffic data, for instance--observing anomalies that would otherwise have been overlooked. We explore various RNN architectures, hyperparameter settings, and feature representations to further improve results. This paper examines problems such as model interpretability, scalability and computing resources which severely limit the practical usability of RNNs in real-world network security situations. We also provide means of making RNN-based anomaly detection systems immune to malicious interference.

articleTitle: Prediction of Brain Tumor Severity with Magnetic Resonance Imaging using Ridge Regression Over Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The goal of the research work is to predict Brain tumors using the Ridge Regression algorithm and compare it with the Recurrent Neural Network. The research study involves two groups, Ridge Regression and Recurrent Neural Network, which were both examined using a sample size of 10 calculated with an alpha value of 0.05 and a confidence interval of 95% using the ClinCalc software. The image analysis dataset used in this study contains 82,347 tuples and was obtained from Kaggle.com. The Ridge Regression algorithm obtained an accuracy of 96.47%, while the Recurrent Neural Network classifier achieved an accuracy of 90.11%. An independent sample t-test conducted in SPSS statistical analysis indicated a statistically significant difference between the two algorithms with a p-value of 0.002 (p<0.05). The results suggest that the Ridge Regression algorithm significantly outperformed the Recurrent Neural Network algorithm in terms of accuracy in predicting Brain tumors.

articleTitle: Carbon Enabled Devices in Digital Era: A Predictive Performance Analysis of CNTFET over Si-NWFET with Conventional Double Gate MOSFET and Single Gate MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this study, the electrical properties of MOSFETs, CNTFETs, and Si-NW FETs are carefully examined. The goal of this research is to determine these devices' performance in terms of a number of electrical metrics, particularly threshold voltage, transconductance, and on/ off current ratio. Simulation strategies were used in the work, and conclusions were compared to the existing evidence from experiments. The results obtained reveal that when compared to Si-NW FETs and MOSFETs, CNTFETs have superior transconductance and lower threshold voltage. The elevated on/off current ratio that CNTFETs shows further qualifies them for low-power applications. Si-NW FETs, as opposed to MOSFETs, show better short-channel effects and a smaller subthreshold slope, Which makes them suitable for high-performance applications.

articleTitle: Time and Accuracy based impact analysis of Poisoning Attack on Support Vector Machine algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The security concerns in the digital world are rapidly evolving. Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning (AI&ML) techniques are not an exception from this concern. None of us wants to stay away from the comforts by avoiding the luxury provided by AI&ML technology-based products. As these are being widely adopted, the risk involved with the weak security posture is a big threat to our community. This paper provides insight to the attacks and their categorization. The work investigates how volatile the ML algorithms are against the cyber-attack by examining the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm against the poisoning attack. The significance is given to the accuracy and time of execution factors among many. Exploring the volatility of ML algorithms against the poisoning attack is a step towards understanding the weakness of ML algorithms, which further allows to explore the various ways to develop the defense mechanisms that prevent such attacks.

articleTitle: Detecting and Diagnosing Brain Tumor MRI Image
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Largely, brain-based illnesses are prevalent in society. The main reason brain diseases occur is because of cell growth. It therefore impacts the brain's regular operation, which in turn impacts the health of other essential organs' functionality. Aggressive brain cancer is ultimately the outcome of cell growth. Early detection of tumors in the brain is one of the primary strategies to lower the number of fatalities from brain tumors. With the help of image processing technique, the images from various sources such as computed tomography (CT) scan, MRI scan, etc. are collected and used for brain tumor detection. The noises in the images are eliminated in the pre-processing stage of the research. The model is developed using deep learning methods including support vector machines (SVM) and convolutional neural networks (CNN). The objective of this research is to create a model that can identify brain tumors from CT scan pictures. We took into account many parameters, including accuracy, recall, loss, and area under the curve , in order to assess the efficacy of the models.

articleTitle: Analysis of Leaf Disease Detection in the Solanaceae family plants using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The paper aims to classifying and predicting diseases for leaf images using random forest and convolutional neural networks and compare these two methods. The Indian economy is heavily dependent on agricultural productivity to meet the demands of citizens and support farmers. Unfortunately, crop diseases and pests lead to significant reductions in crop production and quality, which underscores the importance of early detection in precision agriculture. However, manually identifying these problems over large areas of the farm is both time-consuming and labor-intensive. The current work is implemented for Solanaceae families such as potatoes, tomatoes, and pepper plants. Initially, the Random Forest classification method was implemented, which achieved an accuracy of 67.90%. Further, the experiments with the CNN model extended resulted in a significant improvement with an accuracy level of 95.53% after training and testing.

articleTitle: Hobby Based Learning for Automata Theory and Computability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the traditional form of instruction, the teacher and pupil converse face to face. The discussion is started by the instructor, who generally discusses the material from the required textbooks. Many students might not find the concepts intriguing, which would reduce their ability to concentrate and pay attention in class. This makes learning challenging. A novel teaching strategy that allows pupils to learn a subject depending on their interests has been implemented in the classroom. With this approach, students apply their own hobbies to the subject they wish to learn. It focuses on interest-driven learn. This method focuses on interest driven learning where students apply their Personal interest to the subject they want to learn. A prime example of interest-driven learning is hobby-based learning. Modelling enthusiasm and making the topics relevant to their hobby would make the classroom student centric learning and interest driven learning where student would learn the topic self-directed, enjoy learning process, gain deeper insight on the topic and also develop their hobbies. Hence hobby-based learning was introduced to the classroom for the subject Automata Theory and Computability. A comparative study was made on analysis and data obtained from classrooms with hobby based learning and conventional learning handled by the same instructor on the subject Automata Theory and Computability where hobby-based learning gave significantly best feedback than conventional learning.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Image Captured via PGC and Stereo Vision Using Novel VJ Algorithm in Comparison with Local Binary Pattern Histogram Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The study compares the local binary pattern histogram method to a PGC and stereo vision picture acquired utilising innovative violas jones algorithm. An automated face identification and recognition system was tested utilising the innovative violas jones algorithm and Local Binary Pattern Histogram (LBPH) Algorithm using 20 samples at various periods. The G power with 0.8 pre-testing power, 0.05 alpha, and 0.95 confidence interval is suggested for SPSS accuracy prediction. The model is tested and trained on 40 kaggle (kaggle.com) samples. Automatic face identification and recognition system performance was assessed using the innovative violas jones method and Local Binary Pattern Histogram method with 20 samples at various periods. After statistical analysis, the violas jones algorithm achieved 93% accuracy, while the local binary pattern histogram algorithm achieved 84% accuracy using the default setting. The independent sample t-test significance was =0.001 (<0.05).

articleTitle: Climate Change: The Impact and Exploring The Path Forward
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Climate change has become a widespread topic in recent years. This situation is a result of greenhouse gas emissions that have an big impact on the environment as well as on human beings. Climate change is one of most difficult ongoing problem that humanity is ever going to tackled. This paper deals with the concept of climate, climate change, its causes, impacts on human and environment, solutions and also the policies that has been made by different countries government to tackle the problem of climate change. Numerous attempts has been made by government or NGOs to estimate how climate change would affect biological range in the future and have assumed uniform reactions or shifts with temperature or throughout a species range, but our findings suggest that this may not be a realistic strategy to cope with the problem

Author Keywords: NPACC(National Action Plan on Climate Change)

articleTitle: Cloud-Driven Machine Learning with AWS: A Comprehensive Review of Services
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: With the rise of cloud computing, people now have 24/7 online access to IT resources, which is a transformational force. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a market leader in the field of cloud service providers, providing a broad range of platform, software, and infrastructure services. In this review article, we explore the domain of cloud-driven Machine Learning (ML) with an emphasis on the extensive resources and support provided by AWS. The ability of the AWS ecosystem to provide scalable and effective ML applications is highlighted in this study. It looks at the range of AWS services created to make building, training, and deploying cloud-based ML applications easier. Our analysis includes an AWS Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) product categorization, illuminating the range of resources and options available to ML practitioners. We also take into account findings from comparable studies that have used AWS services for a range of purposes. In conclusion, this article offers a thorough introduction for individuals wishing to explore the world of cloud- driven ML using AWS. It provides insightful information on AWS services, their uses, and how they are influencing ML in the cloud.

articleTitle: Implementation of Internet of things in building smart cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Smart cities and urban planning have emerged as catalysts for national development, equipping society with the ability to make informed decisions promptly. This paper presents a comprehensive system for smart cities and urban planning, driven by IoT-generated Big Data analysis. The proposed architecture comprises four tiers, encompassing data collection, aggregation, communication, processing, and interpretation, with Hadoop technologies and Spark for real-time processing. Basic IoT-generated datasets from diverse smart city domains, including vehicular networks, smart parking, smart homes, weather, pollution, and surveillance, are harnessed to foster urban development and expedite decision-making.The proposed system yields benefit for citizens and authorities alike, empowering them to make intelligent and swift decisions. Efficiency assessments reveal favorable outcomes, even when handling extensive datasets, and highlight the system's scalability with increasing data size. This research underscores the transformative potential of smart city initiatives and their integral role in shaping the future of urban living.

articleTitle: Evaluating Boosting Algorithms for Academic Performance Prediction in E-Learning Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)

authors.preferredName: N S Koti Mani Kumar Tirumanadham

abstract: As educational institutions and platforms get more advanced, predicting academic success is becoming a lot easier. The goal of this research is to find the best boosting algorithm for academic prediction. To do that, we need to go through the data and analyze it. Three popular boosting algorithms, AdaBoost, HistGradientBoosting, and CatBoost were used for comparison analysis and also want a full performance measure assessment. The big winner is CatBoost. In terms of accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and AUC score it outperformed the competition by a long shot. Something truly impressive that CatBoost did was identifying students who may be at risk and decreasing positive predictions so they can focus on areas that need help without being overwhelmed. This study shows how important it is to choose the right algorithm in classifying tasks. Early prediction in e-learning is an important factor in the rapidly changing field of education as technology improves especially since it has potential to improve how students learn and support them with resources.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Aided Privacy Preserving Framework for Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Blockchain has shown tremendous growth in the past few years because of its decentralized and immutable architecture, which makes transactions transparent, making it a feasible choice for authentication and security purposes. Federated learning is a collaborative model training method that can benefit from Blockchain Technology. It is vulnerable to a single point of failure while performing aggregation in a centralized server architecture. Blockchain-aided Federated Learning can be proposed for enhancing the security and privacy of user data together with removing a single aggregator. It also supports a mechanism of giving rewards to users in the form of cryptocurrency to encourage users to follow the protocol. This paper introduces a framework named Blockchain-Aided privacy preserving framework for Federated Learning (BPPF) that helps in model training on the user side with added security and privacy.

articleTitle: Portable Fingerprint Based Attendance System with Raspberry-pi
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A model designed to enhance attendance management in educational institutes, utilizing a Raspberry Pi. It relies on fingerprint sensor to allocate a distinct identity to every student. This valuable data is then securely stored in a local database. The model provides an option to take attendance and store it locally. When an internet connection is available the attendance is sent to the cloud database. The model offers a comprehensive and effortlessly automated solution for efficiently monitoring student attendance during lectures and seamlessly generating the necessary attendance reports to meet institutional needs.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accessibility to Primary Healthcare Centres through the Development and Validation of a Machine Learning-based Gravity Model: Strengthening Public Health Coverage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach, a Machine Learning-based Gravity Model, to address this issue by predicting and mitigating disparities in healthcare access based on geographical location, population distribution, transportation infrastructure, and healthcare workforce availability. The research focuses on the Chikkaballapur district in Karnataka, Southern India, as a proof of concept.The methodology involves developing an optimization model for healthcare facility locations by analyzing the geospatial and demographic characteristics of the district. The goal is to maximize accessibility to primary health units while minimizing the burden on these healthcare facilities. To achieve this, the study considers various factors from the demand side (village population, literacy rates, agricultural and non-agricultural workers, OPD and IPD data, among others), supply side (healthcare staff), and distance and travel (including travel friction). Composite indexes are constructed to represent demand, supply, and travel factors, contributing to the overall accessibility and burden calculations.The study classifies villages based on their accessibility scores, separating them into categories of poor, average, and high accessibility. Similarly, Primary Health Centers (PHCs) are classified as underutilized, average, or overutilized based on their burden scores. Using these classifications, the paper presents case scenarios and a rule-based algorithm to recommend actions, such as upgrading or downgrading PHCs and building new ones, aimed at improving accessibility and addressing burden disparities.In conclusion, the Gravity-Based Optimization Model offers a promising solution to the complex challenge of healthcare accessibility and facility optimization in India.

articleTitle: End to End Model to Reduce the Inference, Jamming, and to Increase the Trust from the Compromised Secondary Nodes in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Wireless technology has advanced dramatically in recent years. Multimedia applications have exploded in popularity over wireless networks. The demand for radio spectrum has expanded as the demand for large capacity for multimedia applications has grown. The traditional fixed spectrum assignment approach has been challenged by the shortage of radio spectrum. As a result, Cognitive Radio (CR) has arisen as a new unique option for addressing spectrum underutilization by allowing users to access unused spectrum bands on the fly. In cognitive radio networks, radio spectrum scarcity, spectrum access, signal interference, security at various layers, trust, jamming, and spectrum management have all become key issues. Proposing a unique approach to address the interference problem produced by secondary nodes that have been hacked. To fulfil the need, we develop a mathematical modelling of the system that incorporates intelligence in the SU to cope with intelligent jammer. Intelligent jammer is cognitive in nature, having the ability to learn, to reason and to adjust its strategies against SU for maximum damage to the CRN. Many researchers have been working on reducing inference and the effect of jamming in the network. But still it is not resulted with the proper solution for the jamming problem in cognitive radio wireless sensor network. Hence proposing the methodology aiming to minimize the effect of Jamming in Cognitive Radio Wireless Sensor-Networks. At the end, the proposed research is aiming to solve the security problem to increase the trust in the cognitive radio network. The secondary users must be able to detect and forecast spectrum holes in the CR environment. The overall result shows the improved network performance by reducing the inference, jamming, spectrum sensing and trust issues in cognitive radio network.

articleTitle: Classification of Online News Articles Using Optimized Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Text mining has gained considerable importance in recent years, especially in the last few. Users can now get information from many different places, such as digital media, print media, electronic media, and others. Text categorization is the method by which researchers organize the huge quantities of unstructured data generated as a result of the broad availability of text in numerous formats. In the accessible corpus of study, these specialists have identified a multitude of techniques for transforming the dispersed text into a defined and organized volume. In this study, we explore the text classification process, classifiers, and multiple feature extraction approaches utilizing the word2vec model, the Google pre-trained model (Google News 300), the RNN, LSTM, GRU, bidirectional, BERT, and the Convolutional 1D model with the Maxout layer. The results of a comparison of the classifiers that are currently available and how they work are shown in an effective way.

articleTitle: A study to identify significant predictors of Employee Satisfaction of Private Security Personnel of Enterprises through Hierarchical Multiple Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the private security industry, there is supposedly a lack of employee satisfaction. The study's goals were to determine the features that impact employee satisfaction of these private security personnel who are usually outsourced personnel hired from the security agencies. The survey instrument was adapted from the Minnesota Satisfaction Questionnaire. Around 50 variables were considered for the study initially. A survey of a random sample of 526 security personnel was conducted serving the enterprises in the Industrial belt of Asansol Durgapur region of South Bengal. A close exploration of the responses revealed that only 14 variables actually impact the satisfaction levels of the security personnel. Exploratory factor analysis further helped us to identify five basic component factors. The significance of each factor was deduced using Hierarchical Multiple regression analysis. The theory based on Two Factors, often known as the motivation-hygiene theory of Herzberg, served as the study's main framework. This study identified five factors impacting employee satisfaction, three motivators - Growth Prospect, Recognition, and the task and two hygiene factors – Peer Group Relations and Managerial Efficiency which further validated the theory in the current situation of study.

articleTitle: IntegraSec: Securing IoT with an Integrated Lightweight Privacy-Aware Publish-Subscribe Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Publish/subscribe(pub/sub) communication in IoT healthcare systems enables efficient and real-time dissemination of patient data, facilitating timely medical interventions and remote monitoring. Moreover, the pub/sub model has characteristics of loose coupling which could lead to security and privacy; this paper introduces a comprehensive security framework IntegraSec which integrates the lightweight design, LAA (Lightweight Authentication based on anonymity), LAC(lightweight access control), principle based on the AE(Asymmetric Encryption) based model integrated with different model such as anonymous authentication through, user registration and so on to enhance the access control and data privacy. Moreover, the proposed model secures the pub/sub model by safeguarding the content, securing the subscriber identity and publication authenticity for lightweight secure communication. Considering the lightweight approach IntegraSec improvises the overhead in terms of storage and communication.

articleTitle: Mastering Commercial Market Predictions: A Stacked Ensemble Approach with Credit Scoring Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Commercial market predictions play a pivotal role in strategic decision-making for businesses, investors, and financial institutions. Accurate predictions enable proactive responses to market dynamics, reducing risks and maximizing opportunities. This paper introduces a novel approach to enhance commercial market predictions by leveraging a stacked ensemble learning techniques and a credit scoring model. The fundamental goal of this study is to generate a strong prediction model that capitalises on the extensive body of data available in financial markets, including credit history, payment behavior, and financial transactions. To achieve this, the research integrates stacked ensemble learning, which combines multiple predictive models to mitigate individual weaknesses and enhance overall performance using different weights of ensemble model. The stacked ensemble learning framework incorporates diverse machine learning models which includes base model as Random Forest (RF), Naïve Bayes (NB), Logistic Regression (LR) and Meta model as LightGBM (Light Gradient Boosting Machine) for commercial market predictions. This research presents a paradigm shift in commercial market predictions, capitalizing on the wealth of financial data and the collective strength of ensemble learning techniques. Based on the Benchmark German Credit dataset, the proposed model is validated. During the tests, the suggested model attained a highest classification accuracy of 97.1%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Malware Detection using Convolutional Neural Network with Robust Ensemble Algorithm-"LIGHTGBM"
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This In the past few years use of the Internet to transfer data has increased rapidly. It is becoming the target of malware that exploits the vulnerabilities of the security system. The rapid evolution of malware threats demands innovative solutions for their detection and classification. In response to this challenge, we present a comprehensive approach that harnesses the power of deep learning and ensemble techniques. Our methodology begins with the utilization of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for feature extraction from malware images sourced from the Malimg dataset, which encompasses 25 distinct classes of malware. Through meticulous data preprocessing, including image resizing and normalization, we ensure a standardized and efficient pipeline. The extracted features serve as rich representations of the malware images, capturing intricate patterns learned by the CNN. We then transition to the ensemble phase, incorporating renowned algorithms such as XGBoost, Random Forest, and LightGBM. Hyperparameter tuning optimizes the ensemble models for classification accuracy and computational speed. Rigorous model evaluation, employing metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC-ROC, reveals insights into the capabilities of our approach. In a landscape where accuracy and efficiency are paramount, our work sets out to provide a holistic solution for the efficient and accurate classification of a diverse range of malware. The Random Forest model would achieve an accuracy of 95%, XGBoost would reach 97%, and LightGBM would attain a remarkable 98%. The computational speed of Random Forest is 58.5%, XGBoost is 29.3% and lightGBM is 12.2%.

articleTitle: An enhanced mutual authentication scheme for healthcare systems using Elgamal and ECC
